zh.summary: 乾卦是《周易》的第一卦，象征天道刚健、创造与进取。卦辞“元亨，利贞”意为大通顺，宜于守正。这一卦强调自强不息，但并非一味冒进，而是讲究时机与分寸。六爻以龙为喻，从潜藏、现身、勤勉、跃试到飞腾，最后警示亢龙有悔，揭示事物发展的完整周期。整体而言，乾卦鼓励积极行动，但提醒我们顺应时势，知进知退，方能长久亨通。
lines: 龙潜伏在深渊，时机未到，不宜轻举妄动。此时应积蓄力量，等待条件成熟。
龙出现在田野，可以崭露头角。此时利于拜见有德有能之人，寻求指引或合作。
君子整日勤勉不懈，夜晚仍保持警惕。处境虽险，但谨慎行事可免过错。
龙或跃起或留在深渊，进退自如，没有灾祸。这是审时度势、灵活抉择的阶段。
龙飞上天空，大展宏图。此时利于遇见贵人，事业将达到高峰，宜把握机遇。
龙飞得过高，会有悔恨。物极必反，盛极而衰，此时应克制欲望，避免过度。
zh.extra: 群龙出现，没有首领，吉祥。象征各展其能、不争权位，反而和谐共生。
zh.career: 事业上问乾卦，是积极进取的信号。当前利于主动开拓，但需把握节奏：初期低调积累，中期寻求合作，高峰时防骄戒躁。若已高位，更需谦逊，避免刚愎自用。
zh.love: 感情上问乾卦，提示主动但要有分寸。初识不宜急切，逐步展现诚意；关系稳定后，需保持热情与责任感，同时尊重对方独立，避免强势主导。
zh.money: 财运上问乾卦，总体向好，但忌贪心冒进。适合长期投资与稳健经营，把握时机果断行动，但见好就收，避免追求极致收益而致损失。
zh.meta: 乾卦：天道刚健，自强不息，但须审时度势，知进知退。

en.summary: Qian, the Creative, is the first hexagram of the I Ching, symbolizing the power of heaven, creativity, and initiative. The judgment 'sublime success through creative power; it furthers to stay true' indicates great progress when aligned with integrity. The six lines use the dragon as a metaphor, tracing a full cycle from hidden potential to soaring achievement, and finally warning against overreaching. The hexagram encourages vigorous action but emphasizes timing and balance: know when to advance, when to rest, and when to yield. It's about harnessing creative energy wisely for lasting success.
lines: A dragon hidden in the deep — do not act yet. Build strength, wait for the right moment.
The dragon appears in the field. Seek out a person of influence for guidance or alliance.
Work hard all day, stay vigilant at night. Though demanding, careful conduct avoids blame.
Poised to leap or stay in the deep — both are fine. Weigh circumstances and choose freely.
The dragon flies in the sky. Now is the time for great achievement; welcome worthy allies.
A dragon flying too high will regret. Extremes reverse; curb ambition, avoid excess.
en.extra: A field of dragons, none claiming leadership: good fortune. Cooperation without power struggles brings harmony.
en.career: In career, Qian indicates a time for initiative and growth. Start with modest groundwork, seek mentors, and when at a peak, stay humble. Avoid overconfidence and rigid control.
en.love: In love, Qian suggests taking initiative but with patience. Build trust gradually, maintain passion and responsibility, and respect each other's independence to avoid dominance.
en.money: Financially, Qian is positive but cautions against greed. Favor long-term, steady investments, act decisively at opportunities, but know when to stop to protect gains.
en.meta: Qian (The Creative): harness your drive with timing and humility for lasting success.

zh.summary: 坤卦讲的是大地之道：柔顺、承载、包容。它像母马一样，靠坚韧和耐心成就大事，而不是靠刚强冲撞。卦辞说‘元亨，利牝马之贞’，意思是通达顺利，但要像母马那样守正、顺从。整个卦提醒我们，在被动的位置上，跟随、配合、积累，反而能走得更远。它不是消极，而是一种主动的承载与滋养。六爻从踩到霜到龙战于野，展示了顺应与过度之间的分寸。
lines: 踩到霜，就知道坚冰快来了。这是提醒你，小事往往预示大事，要见微知著，早做准备。
大地直、方、大，不用刻意学习或造作，也不会不利。保持正直、包容、坦荡，自然能行得通。
心里有才华，但先藏着，可以守正。如果去辅助别人做事，别抢功劳，事情会善终。
像扎紧口袋一样，少说话，不惹事。这样既没有过错，也不会有赞誉，但能保平安。
穿黄色的下裳，黄色是中色，象征谦逊。身居高位却保持低调朴素，这是大吉的。
龙在野地里打架，流的血是黑黄色的。这是说，阴柔过头，跟阳刚硬碰硬，两败俱伤。
zh.extra: 用六：利于长久地守正。坤卦六爻皆阴，提醒你坚持柔顺、正直之道，才能持久。
zh.career: 事业上，坤卦提示你适合做辅助、配合的角色，而不是强行出头。踏实积累，不抢功，最终会有好结果。如果现在处于被动，别急，跟随大流，守好本分，机会会来。
zh.love: 感情上，坤卦强调包容与顺从。多倾听对方，少争对错，关系会更和谐。如果你是主导方，记得放低姿态；如果你是跟随方，保持真诚，耐心经营。
zh.money: 财运上，坤卦建议稳健理财，不要冒进。像大地一样，慢慢积累，适合长期投资或储蓄。避免投机取巧，守正才能保住财富。
zh.meta: 坤卦：大地之道，柔顺承载，守正持久，方得亨通。

en.summary: The Hexagram Kun (The Receptive) embodies the way of the earth: yielding, supportive, and all-embracing. Like a mare, it achieves greatness through steadfastness and endurance, not through force. The judgment speaks of sublime success, but only through the perseverance of a mare — a steady, following strength. This hexagram reminds us that in a receptive position, following and cooperating can carry us far. It is not passivity but active nurturing. The six lines trace a journey from noticing small signs to the cost of overreaching, teaching us the balance between yielding and overstepping.
lines: Frost underfoot: hard ice is on its way. Small signs announce what is coming — be alert to early warnings.
Straight, square, and generous — without forcing, nothing fails to further. Stay honest and open, and things will work out.
Keep your brilliance contained for now. Serve the work without claiming credit; it concludes well.
A tied-up sack: no blame, no praise. Discretion protects you — keep quiet and stay safe.
A yellow lower garment: modest dignity in a high place — supreme fortune. Stay humble even when you're on top.
Dragons battle in the open field, their blood dark and yellow: the cost of overreaching one's role. Pushing beyond your place leads to mutual harm.
en.extra: It furthers to stay steady for the long term. When all lines are yielding, enduring steadfastness is the key.
en.career: In career, Kun suggests playing a supportive role rather than leading forcefully. Steady accumulation and avoiding credit-taking will lead to good results. If you're in a passive position, don't rush; follow the flow and do your duty — opportunities will come.
en.love: In love, Kun emphasizes tolerance and yielding. Listen more, argue less, and harmony grows. If you're the leader, lower your stance; if you follow, stay sincere and patient.
en.money: For finances, Kun advises steady, low-risk management. Build wealth slowly like the earth — good for long-term investments or savings. Avoid speculation; integrity preserves wealth.
en.meta: Hexagram Kun: The Receptive — yield and endure, stay steady, and success follows.

zh.summary: 屯卦讲的是万事开头难。就像草木初生，必须经历破土的艰难。卦辞说“元亨，利贞”，意思是虽然艰难，但前景光明，关键在于守正。此时不宜轻举妄动（勿用有攸往），而应建立根基、寻求支持（利建侯）。整个卦强调在初创阶段，要耐心、积累、等待时机，不要急于求成。
lines: 初九：像大石阻路，徘徊不前。此时宜安守正道，不宜冒进，同时要结交盟友，为将来打基础。
六二：进退两难，骑虎难下。看似有危险，实则是机会。但时机未到，不可强求，要像女子守贞一样，等待十年，终会如愿。
六三：追鹿却没有向导，只会深入林中迷路。聪明人懂得放弃，继续强求只会带来羞辱。
六四：形势好转，骑马来求婚，这次前往是吉利的，没有不利。
九五：恩泽被阻，无法广施。小事上守正可获吉，大事上强行则凶。
上六：骑马盘旋，血泪涟涟。到了穷途末路，此时应停下，不可再进。
zh.career: 事业上，屯卦提示你正处于起步或艰难阶段。不要急于扩张，先稳固基础，建立人脉。小步试错，积累经验。若有大计划，需耐心等待时机成熟。
zh.love: 感情上，屯卦暗示关系进展缓慢，甚至有些波折。不要强求，给彼此时间。建立信任和了解，就像等待十年后的婚约，最终会有好结果。
zh.money: 财运上，屯卦表示求财不易，不宜冒进投资。先储蓄，积累资本，寻找可靠伙伴。小规模尝试可获小利，大规模行动风险高。
zh.meta: 屯卦：万物初生，艰难中蕴含生机，宜守正待时，不宜冒进。

en.summary: Hexagram 3, Difficulty at the Beginning, speaks of the hard birth of all things. Like a sprout pushing through soil, the start is tough, but the promise is great. The key is to stay true. Do not rush forward; instead, build a foundation and gather allies. This hexagram advises patience, accumulation, and waiting for the right moment during the initial phase.
lines: Hesitating at the threshold: stay put, stay true, and gather allies.
Stalled and circling, riders wheeling about — not raiders but suitors. Commitment comes only after a long wait.
Chasing a deer without a guide leads deep into the forest. The wise let go; pressing on brings regret.
The riders turn back for the alliance. Going forward now is fortunate.
Resources are blocked at the source. Small steps succeed; grand moves fail.
Horses wheeling, tears of blood: exhaustion at a dead end. Stop.
en.career: In career, this hexagram indicates a difficult start. Avoid expanding too quickly; first stabilize your base and build connections. Take small, measured steps. For big plans, wait for the right time.
en.love: In love, relationships may progress slowly or face obstacles. Do not force things; give each other time. Building trust and understanding, like waiting for a marriage after ten years, will eventually bring good results.
en.money: For finances, this hexagram suggests that making money is not easy. Avoid risky investments. Save and accumulate capital first, and seek reliable partners. Small-scale attempts may bring small gains; large moves carry high risk.
en.meta: Hexagram 3, Difficulty at the Beginning: a hard start full of potential; stay true and wait, don't rush ahead.

zh.summary: 这一卦讲的是启蒙与学习，强调教育者与学习者的正确关系。卦辞说“匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我”，意为不是老师去求学生，而是学生主动求教。初次诚心求问会得到解答，反复轻慢则不再回应。这提示我们，学习需要主动和诚意，教育要把握时机。整体倾向是亨通有利，但需端正态度，避免亵渎。
lines: 初爻说“发蒙，利用刑人，用说桎梏，以往吝”，意思是启蒙之初，用规矩和惩戒来纠正行为是必要的，但目的是为了脱去束缚，如果一味严苛，就会招致遗憾。
九二爻辞“包蒙吉，纳妇吉，子克家”，讲包容和耐心。对幼稚无知者要有包容之心，就像接纳妻子、儿子能持家一样，宽厚待人可以带来吉祥。
六三爻辞“勿用取女，见金夫，不有躬，无攸利”，提醒不要被表面诱惑所动。追逐财势之人会丧失自我，这样的结合没有好处。
六四爻辞“困蒙，吝”，说困于蒙昧，远离明师，结果会遭羞辱。这告诫我们要主动求教，避免孤立。
六五爻辞“童蒙，吉”，保持孩童般的谦逊和求知欲，是吉祥的。这说明虚心求教的态度本身就是福气。
上九爻辞“击蒙，不利为寇，利御寇”，讲对愚昧的纠正要适度。攻击愚昧是为了防御，而非侵略，否则会适得其反。
zh.career: 事业上，此卦提示要主动学习，虚心求教，不要自以为是。初期可能需要严格规范，但最终要放手让下属成长。避免因利益诱惑而失去原则。
zh.love: 感情上，此卦强调真诚和主动。不要被外表或财富迷惑，要看清本质。保持孩童般的好奇和包容，关系才能长久。
zh.money: 财运上，此卦警示不要被眼前的利益诱惑，不要轻信他人，要谨慎投资。学习理财知识，主动求教，才能避免损失。
zh.meta: 山水蒙：启蒙之道，贵在主动求教，真诚不渎，以包容之心开启智慧。

en.summary: This hexagram is about enlightenment and learning, emphasizing the correct relationship between teacher and student. The text says "It is not I who seek the young fool, but the young fool seeks me." A sincere first question receives an answer; repeated pestering gets none. This suggests that learning requires initiative and sincerity, and teaching must seize the right moment. The overall tendency is favorable, but one must maintain a proper attitude and avoid trivializing the process.
lines: Opening ignorance: discipline helps at first, but the shackles must come off — prolonged harshness brings regret.
Patience with the inexperienced brings fortune. Taking in a partner is fortunate; the young can carry the house.
Do not commit to one who chases whatever glitters. Nothing furthers there.
Stuck in ignorance, cut off from any teacher: humiliation.
Open, childlike willingness to learn: good fortune.
Strike at ignorance — to defend against wrong, never to avenge it.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises taking the initiative to learn and seek guidance, not being arrogant. Initial discipline may be necessary, but eventually, you should let subordinates grow. Avoid being swayed by profit and lose your principles.
en.love: In love, sincerity and initiative are key. Don't be fooled by appearances or wealth; see the essence. Maintain childlike curiosity and tolerance for a lasting relationship.
en.money: In finance, beware of temptations and don't trust others easily. Invest cautiously. Learn about financial matters and seek advice to avoid losses.
en.meta: Youthful Folly (Meng): The path of enlightenment lies in active seeking, sincerity, and tolerance to open the mind.

zh.summary: 需卦讲的是等待的智慧。卦辞说，心怀诚信，光明通达，坚守正道可获吉祥，利于渡过大河。这告诉我们，在时机未成熟时，要耐心等待，积蓄力量，而不是急躁冒进。等待不是消极，而是积极的准备，就像水在天上，终将化为雨露。全卦以“需”为主线，从郊外到泥泞，再到酒食，展现了等待的不同阶段和应对之道，强调在等待中保持恒心、谨慎和恭敬，最终能化险为夷。
lines: 在郊野等待，远离危险。保持平常心，按部就班，就不会有灾祸。
在沙滩等待，靠近水边，会招来闲言碎语，但最终吉祥。
在泥泞中等待，过于接近危险，会招来盗寇。此时应警惕，不可冒进。
在血泊中等待，要从穴中出来，即脱离险境，及时抽身。
在酒食中等待，安然自若，坚守正道，吉祥。
进入洞穴，有三位不速之客到来，恭敬相待，最终吉祥。
zh.career: 事业上，需卦提示你当前处于等待期，不宜急于求成。保持诚信和耐心，做好手头工作，等待合适时机。若已接近关键节点，要谨慎行事，避免因冒进而引发问题。最终会因坚持正道而获得成功。
zh.love: 感情上，需卦建议你耐心等待，不要强求。保持真诚，给彼此空间和时间，让感情自然发展。若遇到摩擦，以恭敬和包容相待，最终关系会趋于和谐。
zh.money: 财运上，需卦表示财富积累需要时间，不宜投机冒进。稳扎稳打，保持诚信，等待投资时机成熟。若有风险，及时规避，终会获得回报。
zh.meta: 需卦：等待的智慧——心怀诚信，耐心守正，终能涉险成功。

en.summary: The Hexagram Waiting (Xu) speaks of the wisdom of patience. The judgment says: with sincerity, there is shining success; steadfastness brings fortune, and even great rivers can be crossed. This teaches that when the time is not ripe, we should wait calmly, building strength rather than rushing ahead. Waiting is not passive but active preparation, like water in the sky that will eventually fall as rain. The hexagram's six lines illustrate stages of waiting—from the outskirts to the mud, then to feasting—offering guidance on how to wait with constancy, caution, and respect, ultimately turning danger into good fortune.
lines: Waiting on the outskirts, far from danger. Keep your ordinary rhythm; no blame.
Waiting on the sand, close enough to draw some talk — it still ends well.
Waiting in the mud invites the raiders. You have moved too close too soon.
Waiting amid blood: climb out of the pit. Withdraw from the danger zone.
Waiting over food and wine: nourish yourself calmly. Steadiness brings fortune.
Down in the pit, three uninvited guests arrive. Receive them with respect and all ends well.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests you are in a waiting period; don't rush. Stay sincere and patient, do your current work well, and wait for the right moment. If you are near a critical point, act cautiously to avoid problems. Success will come through steadfastness.
en.love: In love, it advises patience and not forcing things. Be genuine, give each other space and time, and let the relationship develop naturally. If friction arises, treat it with respect and tolerance, and harmony will eventually prevail.
en.money: In wealth, it indicates that accumulation takes time; avoid speculation. Be steady, maintain integrity, and wait for the right investment opportunity. If there are risks, avoid them in time, and you will eventually see returns.
en.meta: Hexagram Waiting (Xu): the wisdom of patience—stay sincere, wait steadily, and you can cross even great rivers.

zh.summary: 讼卦讲的是争讼、冲突。卦辞说，心中有诚信却被阻塞，所以要警惕，中途停止是吉利的，坚持到底则有凶险。遇到公正的权威人物有利，但不宜冒险渡过大河（指不宜做冒险的大事）。整体上，这一卦提醒我们，冲突本身不是好事，能和解就和解，不要争强好胜。
lines: 不要把事情拖得太久，稍微有点言语上的摩擦，最终会吉利。
这场官司打不赢，退回去躲起来，自己家乡的人不会受牵连。
靠过去的积蓄生活，虽然处境危险，但最终吉利。如果为君王做事，不要居功。
打不赢官司，回头接受现实，改变心态，安于正道，吉利。
把争端交给真正公正的人来裁决，大吉大利。
靠争斗得来的荣誉腰带，一天之内就被剥夺三次。
zh.career: 事业上，你可能正面临竞争或纠纷。建议不要硬碰硬，尽量协商解决。如果无法避免，寻求上级或公正的第三方调解。保持低调，不要贪功，最终会有好结果。
zh.love: 感情上，你们可能有些争执。记住，赢了道理可能输了感情。退一步海阔天空，多倾听对方，不要争对错。耐心沟通，关系才能长久。
zh.money: 财运上，不宜进行高风险投资或冒险扩张。守成为上，避免卷入经济纠纷。如果已有纠纷，尽快和解，避免损失扩大。
zh.meta: 讼卦：冲突与和解的智慧，教你如何在争执中保全自己，以退为进。

en.summary: The Hexagram Conflict is about disputes and confrontation. The judgment says that when sincerity is blocked, one must be cautious. Stopping halfway brings good fortune, but pushing to the end brings disaster. It is favorable to seek help from a fair authority, but not to attempt great, risky endeavors. Overall, this hexagram reminds us that conflict itself is not good; reconciliation is preferable to winning at all costs.
lines: Don't drag the dispute out. A few sharp words, then it settles well.
This fight cannot be won. Withdraw quietly and your own people stay safe.
Live on what you have already earned. Precarious, but it ends well; serve without claiming the result.
Unable to prevail, you turn back and accept what is — changed, at peace, fortunate.
The conflict brought before one truly just: supreme good fortune.
A belt of honor won by fighting is stripped away three times before the morning ends.
en.career: In your career, you may face competition or disputes. Avoid confrontation; seek negotiation. If unavoidable, ask for mediation from a fair superior. Stay humble and don't claim credit; things will turn out well.
en.love: In love, you may have disagreements. Remember, winning an argument may lose the relationship. Step back, listen, and don't fight over who's right. Patience and communication will sustain the bond.
en.money: For finances, avoid high-risk investments or aggressive expansion. Be conservative and steer clear of legal or financial disputes. If one arises, settle it quickly to minimize losses.
en.meta: Conflict Hexagram: wisdom for handling disputes, knowing when to yield, and seeking fair resolution.

zh.summary: 师卦讲的是组织与纪律，如同军队作战。卦辞强调，由德高望重的长者统帅，坚守正道，才能无咎。全卦以军队的纪律、指挥、进退为喻，说明在集体行动中，纪律严明、用人得当、进退有度是成功的关键。它提醒我们，无论是团队协作还是个人处事，都需要有章法、有原则，避免混乱和盲目。
lines: 初六：军队出动必须有严格的纪律。如果纪律败坏，无论出于什么理由，都会导致凶险。
九二：将领身在军中，能获得士兵的信任，所以吉祥无咎，还多次受到君王的嘉奖。
六三：军队打了败仗，用车载回尸体，这是因为指挥不当，导致凶险。
六四：军队暂时后退扎营，以避敌锋芒，这不是失败，而是策略，所以没有灾祸。
六五：田里有禽兽来犯，才去猎捕，这样行动有正当理由，没有灾祸。让有才能的人统帅军队，让不称职的人参与指挥，即使初衷正确，也会导致凶险。
上六：君王论功行赏，封赏功臣，但绝不能让小人掌权。
zh.career: 事业上，师卦提示你要注重团队纪律和领导力。如果你是领导者，需以身作则，公正严明；如果是执行者，需服从指挥，遵守规则。避免多头指挥或任人唯亲，否则易招致失败。当前宜稳扎稳打，不宜冒进。
zh.love: 感情上，师卦强调责任和秩序。关系需要双方共同维护，有章法、有承诺。若有一方过于强势或混乱，可能导致矛盾。建议坦诚沟通，明确彼此的角色和期望，像军队一样有纪律地经营感情，才能长久。
zh.money: 财运上，师卦提示投资理财需有纪律和策略。不要凭一时冲动行事，要像军队一样有计划、有止损。听从专业意见，避免盲目跟风。如果出现风险，及时撤退以保本金，等待时机再行动。
zh.meta: 师卦：纪律与统帅之道。以军队为喻，强调组织、纪律和用人，是团队与个人行动的指南。

en.summary: The Army hexagram is about organization and discipline, using a military campaign as a metaphor. The judgment says that with a seasoned leader and adherence to what is right, there is no blame. Each line illustrates a principle: strict discipline at the start, trust between leader and troops, the danger of divided command, the wisdom of strategic retreat, the importance of acting only with clear justification and capable leadership, and the need to reward the worthy while excluding the petty. The overall message is that success in any collective endeavor depends on clear rules, wise leadership, and disciplined action.
lines: An army must march out in order. A disorderly campaign fails, whatever its cause.
The leader stands among the troops: fortune, no blame, and threefold recognition from above.
The army carts back its dead: divided command is disaster.
Falling back to regroup is not defeat. No blame.
Act only on a real intrusion, with clear warrant. Command to the capable, not the favored — else even a right cause ends in ruin.
Victory is rewarded: found domains for the worthy — but never hand power to the small.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises strict discipline and clear leadership. If you lead, be fair and exemplary; if you follow, respect the chain of command. Avoid divided authority or nepotism, as they lead to failure. Steady progress is better than reckless moves.
en.love: In love, it stresses responsibility and order. A relationship needs mutual commitment and clear boundaries. Avoid chaos or dominance; communicate openly and define roles. Like a well-disciplined army, a structured relationship thrives.
en.money: For finances, it warns against impulsive moves. Invest with a plan and stop-loss rules. Seek professional advice and avoid herd mentality. If risks appear, retreat strategically to protect capital, then wait for better opportunities.
en.meta: The Army hexagram: discipline and leadership. Using military metaphors, it guides collective action and personal conduct with order and wisdom.

zh.summary: 比卦讲的是亲近与联合。卦辞说，亲近之道本吉，但前提是动机纯正、长久不变，这样才没有咎害。那些不安定的人会前来归附，但若迟迟不来，就会陷入凶险。比卦强调真诚与主动，提醒我们选择伙伴、建立关系时，要出于真心，而非算计。同时，比卦也警示，不要依附于不当之人，也不要等到最后才行动，否则会失去先机。整体而言，比卦鼓励我们以诚信和开放的心态去团结他人，但也要审慎选择，避免落入困境。
lines: 初六：有诚信来亲近，没有咎害。诚信像装满瓦罐一样充盈，最终会有意外的收获，吉祥。
六二：从内心真诚地亲近贤者，守正则吉。
六三：亲近了不该亲近的人，这是危险的信号。
六四：向外亲近贤明的人，守正则吉。
九五：光明正大地亲近众人。就像君王打猎，只围三面，放走前面的猎物，百姓不惊惧，吉祥。
上六：亲近却没有首领，凶险。
zh.career: 事业上，比卦提示你应主动与同事、伙伴建立真诚的合作关系，但需谨慎选择对象。若你处于领导位置，应公开公正地团结团队，避免小圈子。若迟迟不融入团队或错过关键合作，可能错失良机。建议以诚信为本，积极沟通，但不要依附于不靠谱的人。
zh.love: 感情上，比卦强调真诚与主动。若你单身，应敞开心扉，真诚交往，但需观察对方是否值得信赖。若已有伴侣，应加强沟通，彼此坦诚，共同维系关系。切忌三心二意或依附于不健康的关系。若因犹豫而错过良缘，则可能后悔。
zh.money: 财运上，比卦提示合作生财，但需谨慎选择合作伙伴。不要盲目跟风或听信他人，应基于诚信和长期眼光进行投资。若早期参与优质项目，可能获得丰厚回报，但若犹豫不决或加入过晚，则可能失利。保持开放心态，但也要有原则。
zh.meta: 比卦讲亲近与联合，以诚信为本，主动却审慎，晚来者凶。

en.summary: The Bi hexagram is about forming alliances and building close relationships. The judgment says that holding together brings fortune, but only if your motives are sincere and your commitment is long-lasting. Those who are unsettled will come, but those who arrive too late will be lost. This hexagram emphasizes sincerity and initiative, reminding us to choose companions and build relationships from the heart, not from calculation. It also warns against attaching to unworthy people or waiting too long, which can lead to missed opportunities. Overall, it encourages uniting with others through trust and openness, while being cautious in selection to avoid pitfalls.
lines: Sincerity is the whole basis of the bond. Fill the plain clay jar with trust, and unexpected good arrives.
Bond from your own inner conviction: steady fortune.
Bound to the wrong people — the warning is the message.
Reach outward, openly, to the worthy: steady fortune.
Lead the alliance openly — like the king who leaves one side of the hunt open. Those free to leave, stay truly.
An alliance joined too late, with no head to it: misfortune.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises you to proactively build sincere cooperative relationships with colleagues and partners, but choose carefully. If you lead, unite the team openly and fairly, avoiding cliques. If you delay integrating or miss key collaborations, you may lose opportunities. Act with integrity, communicate actively, but do not rely on unreliable people.
en.love: In love, this hexagram emphasizes sincerity and initiative. If single, open your heart and date honestly, but observe if the other is trustworthy. If in a relationship, enhance communication, be transparent, and nurture the bond together. Avoid half-heartedness or attaching to unhealthy relationships. Hesitation may cause you to miss a good match.
en.money: In finance, this hexagram suggests that cooperation brings wealth, but choose partners carefully. Do not blindly follow others; base decisions on trust and long-term vision. Early participation in quality projects may yield returns, but hesitation or late entry may lead to losses. Stay open yet principled.
en.meta: Hexagram 8, Holding Together, urges sincere and timely alliances; latecomers face misfortune.

zh.summary: 这一卦讲的是小有积蓄、时机未至的状态。就好比西边乌云密布，却还没下雨，事情在酝酿，但火候不到。整体是亨通的，关键在于耐心积累，不要急于求成。卦辞提醒我们，条件尚未成熟，强行推进只会事倍功半。此时宜收敛锋芒，专注自身，厚积薄发。爻辞从回归正道、与人携手，到中途的波折，再到最终雨落功成，描绘了一个完整的积累过程，强调诚信与分享的重要性。
lines: 回到自己的路上，有什么过错呢？吉祥。意思是回归正道，脚踏实地，不会有问题。
被同伴拉着一起回来，也是吉祥的。与人携手，互相扶持，能走得更稳。
车轮的辐条散了，夫妻反目。比喻强行推进导致内部矛盾，关系破裂，要小心。
心怀诚信，就能避免流血和恐惧，没有灾祸。真诚能化解危机。
诚信像绳子一样连在一起，富裕了要分享给邻居。财富因分享而增值。
雨终于下了，就停下来安顿。再往前，即使感觉对，也会招来凶险。见好就收，别贪。
zh.career: 事业上，这一卦提示目前是积累阶段，可能进展缓慢，但方向正确。建议稳扎稳打，提升自身能力，多与同事合作，不要急于求成。时机成熟时，自然会水到渠成。
zh.love: 感情上，小畜卦提醒你，关系需要慢慢培养，急不得。如果出现摩擦，要反思是否强求对方改变。以诚信和耐心对待，感情会逐渐升温。
zh.money: 财运上，这一卦表示财富在缓慢积累，不宜冒险投资。适合储蓄和稳健理财。与人合作时，诚信能带来更多机会。记住，分享财富能带来更大的回报。
zh.meta: 小畜卦：密云不雨，时机未至，宜积累诚信与实力，静待时机。

en.summary: This hexagram speaks of a time of small accumulation, when conditions are not yet ripe. Like dense clouds gathering from the west without rain, things are brewing but not ready. The overall tone is favorable, but the key is patience and steady preparation. Pushing forward prematurely will only waste effort. The advice is to focus on self-cultivation and build up resources quietly. The lines trace a journey from returning to the right path, through partnership and setbacks, to the eventual rain that brings completion, emphasizing sincerity and sharing.
lines: Returning to your own path—what blame could there be? Fortune. Stay true to your course; no fault in that.
Drawn back together with like-minded others: fortune. Walking with companions makes the journey steadier.
The cart's spokes come loose; partners turn on each other. Forcing things forward strains relationships; beware.
With sincerity, bloodshed is averted and fear departs. No blame. Genuine trust can defuse crises.
Trust binds neighbor to neighbor; prosperity is shared. Wealth grows when shared with others.
The rain has fallen; stop and settle. Pressing further now—however right it feels—invites misfortune. Know when to stop.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests a period of accumulation. Progress may be slow, but the direction is right. Focus on building skills, cooperate with colleagues, and avoid rushing. When the time is ripe, success will come naturally.
en.love: In love, Small Taming reminds you that relationships take time. If friction arises, reflect on whether you're forcing change. With sincerity and patience, feelings will deepen gradually.
en.money: Financially, this hexagram indicates slow wealth accumulation. Avoid risky investments; opt for savings and steady plans. In partnerships, honesty brings opportunities. Sharing wealth leads to greater returns.
en.meta: Small Taming: Dense clouds but no rain yet—time to accumulate integrity and strength, and wait for the right moment.

zh.summary: 履卦讲的是踩在老虎尾巴上，但老虎没有咬人，亨通。这卦的核心是：身处险境，只要态度谨慎、行为得当，就能化险为夷。它强调按规矩行事，像踩虎尾一样小心翼翼，同时保持内心的纯正和清醒。卦辞提醒我们，危险不是靠蛮力解决的，而是靠智慧和节制。整体倾向是：环境有压力，但通过谨慎和自律，可以平安渡过，甚至有所成就。
lines: 初九：穿着朴素的鞋子走路，保持本色，不刻意装饰，这样前往没有灾祸。意思是行动要简单实在，不玩虚的。
九二：走在平坦的大道上，幽静的人守正就会吉祥。这里说，内心安静、不浮躁，按正道走，路自然顺畅。
六三：眼睛看不清却硬要看，腿脚不便却硬要走，结果踩到虎尾被咬，凶险。这比喻能力不足却逞强，或越权行事，会招祸。
九四：踩到虎尾时，保持恐惧谨慎，最终吉祥。这是说，在危险面前，害怕并小心应对，反而能安全过关。
九五：决然前行，像用刀切一样果断，但守正仍有危险。提醒我们，即使坚定，也要警惕，不能大意。
上九：回看走过的路，考察吉凶征兆，如果行为圆满，回来就大吉。这是总结过去，善始善终，结果自然好。
zh.career: 事业上，履卦提示你正处在一个需要谨慎应对的阶段，可能面临压力或挑战，但只要你按规矩办事，不冒进，就能顺利。尤其要注意，不要高估自己，做超出能力的事，否则会吃亏。保持低调和专注，稳步推进，会有好结果。
zh.love: 感情上，这卦提醒你，关系需要小心经营，像踩虎尾一样，不能掉以轻心。保持真诚和单纯，不要耍心机，也不要强求对方改变。如果双方都能守本分，关系会平稳发展。若有矛盾，要谨慎处理，避免冲动。
zh.money: 财运上，履卦意味着财务上可能有风险，但通过谨慎管理可以避免损失。不要贪快钱，不要做超出自己财务能力的投资。保持节俭和稳健，按计划行事，财运才能亨通。如果之前有失误，回顾并总结经验，能转危为安。
zh.meta: 履卦：踩虎尾而不被咬，谨慎行事，化险为夷。

en.summary: The Treading hexagram is about stepping on a tiger's tail without being bitten, indicating success through careful conduct. It emphasizes that in dangerous situations, if you act with caution and propriety, you can turn risk into safety. The core message is to follow rules, tread lightly, and maintain inner integrity and clarity. The overall tendency is that while circumstances may be stressful, through prudence and self-discipline, you can pass through unharmed and even achieve something.
lines: Walk plainly, as you are. No blame. Act simply and genuinely, without pretense.
A level, open road; the quiet one who stays true is fortunate. Inner calm and adherence to the right path make the way smooth.
Half-seeing, half-able, yet charging ahead — the tiger bites. Bravado beyond one's station brings disaster.
Treading the tiger's tail with extreme caution: it ends well. Fear and careful handling in danger lead to safety.
Walking with hard resolve: correct — and still dangerous. Stay aware. Even determination requires vigilance.
Look back over the whole path walked. If the record is sound, its completion brings great fortune. Reflect on your actions; a good track record yields good results.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests you are in a phase requiring caution. You may face pressure or challenges, but if you follow rules and avoid rushing, you'll succeed. Be careful not to overestimate your abilities or take on more than you can handle. Stay low-key and focused; steady progress will bring good outcomes.
en.love: In love, it reminds you that relationships need careful handling, like treading on a tiger's tail. Stay sincere and simple, avoid manipulation or forcing change. If both partners stick to their roles, the relationship will develop smoothly. If there are conflicts, handle them with care and avoid impulsive actions.
en.money: In finance, the Treading hexagram indicates potential risks, but careful management can avert losses. Avoid get-rich-quick schemes and investments beyond your means. Maintain frugality and steadiness; follow your plan to see financial success. If you've had past mistakes, reviewing them can turn the tide.
en.meta: Treading: step on the tiger's tail without being bitten — careful conduct turns danger into success.

zh.summary: 泰卦讲的是天地交泰、阴阳调和，小往大来，即付出小、收获大，整体吉顺亨通。但泰卦也提醒，安泰之中潜藏危机，盛极必衰，因此要居安思危，保持谦逊和警惕。爻辞从拔茅连根开始，强调团结同道，接着讲包容、果敢、中道，然后指出道路有起伏，需坚守正道，再讲放下身段、以诚待人，最后以帝乙嫁女象征谦卑得福，但上六警示城复于隍，泰极否来，不可用强，应自我反省。
lines: 拔起一根茅草，会连带出同类。这暗示行动时与志同道合的人一起，就能顺利前进，吉祥。
要有包容荒秽的胸怀，有徒步过河的勇气，不遗忘远方的人，不结党营私，这样才能符合中正之道，得到支持。
没有只平不坡的路，没有只去不回的循环。在艰难时坚守正道，就没有灾祸，不必担忧诚信，自有福报。
像鸟儿轻快飞下，不靠财富炫耀，而是以诚信与邻人相处，这样即使不富有，也能得到信任。
帝乙下嫁女儿，放下尊贵，以谦卑换来福祉，这是至为吉祥的。
城墙倒塌在壕沟里。此时不宜动用武力，应从自身发布命令，反省调整，即使守正也有憾惜，因为泰极将否。
zh.career: 事业上，泰卦是吉兆，但非高枕无忧。宜与同事协作，发挥团队力量；同时要有包容心和魄力，敢于开拓。但也要注意，成功时勿骄纵，应稳扎稳打，居安思危，防患于未然。
zh.love: 感情上，泰卦预示和谐顺畅。单身者易遇良缘，应主动出击；有伴者关系融洽，但需保持平等尊重，避免因得意而忽视对方感受，多沟通可增进亲密。
zh.money: 财运上，泰卦是财运亨通之象，小投入大回报。但不宜激进投机，应稳健理财，同时注意乐善好施，与人分享财富，避免因贪心而致损失。
zh.meta: 泰卦：天地交泰，小往大来，吉亨。但居安思危，防盛极而衰。

en.summary: The Peace hexagram signifies a time of harmony and prosperity, when the small departs and the great arrives. It suggests that by aligning with others and following the natural course, one can achieve success. However, it also warns that peace is not eternal; prosperity can turn to decline, so one must remain vigilant and humble. The lines illustrate principles like cooperation, tolerance, courage, perseverance, humility, and the importance of self-reflection when times change. Overall, it's a positive omen but with a reminder to stay grounded.
lines: Pull one reed and its roots bring the others: advance together with your kind. This suggests that acting in unison with like-minded people brings good fortune.
Bear with the flawed, dare the crossing, forget no one far away, keep no faction — and walk the middle path. Embrace tolerance and courage; avoid cliques, and you'll gain support.
No plain without a slope, no going without return. Stay steady through the hard stretch and your provision holds. Persevere through difficulties; your integrity will see you through.
Coming down lightly to meet those below, trusting rather than displaying wealth. Approach others with humility and sincerity, not with showy riches, to earn trust.
The sovereign marries his daughter downward: blessing through humility — supreme fortune. By humbling yourself, you invite great blessings.
The wall falls back into the moat. The cycle turns: do not fight it with force. Attend to your own precinct. When decline comes, don't resist with force; instead, reflect and adjust internally.
en.career: In career, this hexagram is auspicious but not a guarantee of ease. Work with your team, be open-minded and bold, yet remain cautious and plan for the long term to avoid complacency.
en.love: In love, Peace indicates harmony. Singles may meet a good match; couples should maintain equality and communication to deepen their bond.
en.money: Financially, it's a favorable time for small investments with good returns. Avoid speculation; manage money wisely and share wealth to prevent loss.
en.meta: Peace: Heaven and earth in harmony, small goes, great comes. But stay vigilant against decline.

zh.summary: 否卦描述的是天地不交、上下不通的闭塞时期，如同小人当道，君子道消。卦辞说“否之匪人，不利君子贞”，意为在这样的时候，坚持正道未必有利，因为大德离去，小利纷至。但这并非绝望之卦，而是提醒我们审时度势：在逆境中保全自身，等待转机。六爻展示了从初时的隐忍退避，到中期的坚守与羞惭，再到后期的转危为安，最终否极泰来。整体上，这一卦强调在不利环境中保持清醒，不随波逐流，以待时变。
lines: 初六：拔茅草连根带起，同类相随。此时应当与志同道合者一起退隐，坚守正道，虽处困境，但吉祥亨通。
六二：小人曲意奉承，得以升迁；大人（君子）在闭塞中坚守本心，不与同流，反而亨通。这是对君子品格的考验。
六三：内心感到羞愧。因为自己可能因贪图小利而卷入不当之事，虽未显露，但已有隐患，应当反省。
九四：天命（转机）降临，没有灾祸。此时可以行动，与同伴一起分享福泽，但需顺应时势。
九五：闭塞将要停止，大人吉祥。但仍要警惕“其亡其亡”，像系在桑树根上一样牢固，才能避免复败。
上九：闭塞彻底倾覆，先有阻隔，后有喜悦。否极泰来，最终迎来转机。
zh.extra: （否卦无用九用六，此字段省略）
zh.career: 事业上，此卦提示当前环境可能不顺，小人得势，努力难有回报。建议不要强出头，宜低调积累，等待时机。若已有职位，要坚守原则，避免同流合污。转机可能在后期出现，但需提前准备，稳固根基。
zh.love: 感情上，此卦显示关系可能陷入僵局，沟通不畅，价值观有分歧。此时不宜强求，应冷静观察，保持自我。若对方品行不端，要果断止损。若双方都愿坚守，经过考验后感情会更牢固。
zh.money: 财运上，此卦警示不宜冒险投资，市场可能低迷或陷阱多。守成为上，避免被小利诱惑。同时要检查自身财务漏洞，像系于苞桑一样稳固根基。待环境转好后再行动。
zh.meta: 否卦：天地不交，闭塞之时，宜守正待时，否极泰来。

en.summary: The Hexagram of Standstill (Pi) describes a period when heaven and earth do not communicate, and the superior person's path is blocked while the inferior gains influence. The hexagram statement says, 'Standstill. The wrong sort hold the field; the great departs, the small arrives. Not the season to press your cause.' This is not a message of despair but a call to discern the times: preserve yourself in adversity and wait for the turning point. The six lines show a progression from initial retreat, through steadfast endurance and hidden shame, to the loosening of blockage and final reversal. Overall, it advises maintaining clarity and integrity in unfavorable conditions, without drifting with the tide, to await the change.
lines: Withdraw together with your kind, principles intact: fortune within retreat.
The small accommodate their way upward; the great endure the standstill without joining — that is their success.
They carry a hidden shame. Complicity always bills later.
When the mandate comes, act — you and yours will share in the blessing.
The standstill loosens. Whisper 'it could fail, it could fail' — and bind your position to the mulberry's deep roots.
The standstill topples over: first blockage, then joy.
en.extra: This hexagram has no extra line.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests the current environment may be unfavorable, with the wrong people in power and little reward for effort. Do not force issues; instead, keep a low profile and accumulate strength. If you hold a position, maintain your principles and avoid collusion. A turning point may come later, but prepare in advance and secure your base.
en.love: In love, this hexagram indicates a possible stalemate in the relationship, with poor communication and differing values. Do not push now; observe calmly and preserve your own integrity. If the other party is of poor character, decisively cut losses. If both are willing to persevere, the relationship will strengthen after the test.
en.money: In finances, this hexagram warns against risky investments; the market may be sluggish or full of traps. Preserve capital and avoid being tempted by small gains. Also, review your financial weaknesses and make your position as secure as a mulberry root. Act only when the environment improves.
en.meta: Hexagram of Standstill (Pi): Heaven and earth do not communicate, a time of blockage; hold to integrity and await reversal.

zh.summary: 同人卦讲的是人与人之间的合作与共识。卦辞说，在旷野中与人同心，能亨通，利于渡过大河，也利于君子守正。这暗示着开放、公正的联盟才能成事，而偏私狭隘则会带来阻碍。六爻展示了从家门口的相遇，到宗族小圈子的局限，再到因猜忌而停滞、因克制而转机，最终历经波折后的大团圆，以及虽未完全融合却也无悔的郊外之谊。整体上，此卦鼓励真诚、广泛的合作，警惕小团体和私心。
lines: 初九：在家门口与人同心，来者不拒，没有过错。这是最自然、最开放的交往状态，不设门槛，不问出身。
六二：只在宗族内部同心，会有遗憾。把自己困在熟人圈子里，格局变小，机会也变少，长远看是损失。
九三：把武器藏在草丛里，又爬上高坡窥探，三年都不敢行动。这是因为猜忌和防备而陷入僵局，白白消耗时光。
九四：已经爬上城墙，却选择不进攻，转回寻求同心，这是吉祥的。克制冲动，放下对抗，反而能赢得人心。
九五：与人同心，先痛哭后欢笑。经过巨大的冲突和努力，伙伴们终于冲破阻碍，重新相聚。
上九：在郊外与人同心，虽然关系不深，但也没有悔恨。保持距离的友谊，只要真诚，也值得珍惜。
zh.career: 事业上，同人卦提示你重视团队协作，避免单打独斗或拉帮结派。开放、透明的合作能带来突破，而内部猜忌或小圈子只会拖慢进度。若有冲突，主动化解比对抗更有利。
zh.love: 感情上，同人卦鼓励坦诚交流，扩大共同圈子。若只黏在二人小世界或各自封闭，易生隔阂。经历争吵后若能真诚和解，关系会更牢固。
zh.money: 财运上，同人卦建议与人合伙或借助人脉，但要选对伙伴，避免因私利而失信。公开透明的财务安排能带来好运，而暗箱操作或只顾自己则易生纠纷。
zh.meta: 同人卦：开放合作，真诚待人，才能亨通。

en.summary: The Hexagram of Fellowship is about cooperation and consensus among people. The judgment says that fellowship in the open field brings success and can cross great rivers, provided one stays steadfast. This suggests that open, fair alliances achieve things, while partiality and narrowness create obstacles. The lines show progression from meeting at the gate, to the limits of clan cliques, to paralysis from distrust, to a fortunate turn away from attack, to a reunion after struggle, and finally to a distant but genuine fellowship. Overall, the hexagram encourages sincere, broad cooperation and warns against small-mindedness.
lines: Fellowship at the gate, open to whoever comes: no blame. The most natural, open state of relating, without barriers or status checks.
Fellowship kept inside the clan: regret. Trapping yourself in a familiar circle shrinks your world and opportunities; in the long run it's a loss.
Weapons hidden in the thicket, watching from the high hill — three years without daring to rise. Suspicion and defensiveness freeze you, wasting time.
Mounted on the wall, yet choosing not to attack: the turn back toward fellowship is fortunate. Restraining aggression and seeking common ground wins hearts.
In fellowship, first wailing, then laughter: after great struggle the companions break through and meet. Conflict and effort lead to reunion.
Fellowship at the outskirts — real, though never fully joined: no regrets. A distant friendship, as long as sincere, is still worth having.
en.career: In career, this hexagram urges teamwork and open cooperation. Avoid going it alone or forming cliques. Transparent collaboration can break through, while internal suspicion or factionalism only slows progress. If conflicts arise, proactively resolve them rather than confront.
en.love: In love, it encourages honest communication and expanding shared circles. Sticking only to a two-person bubble or staying closed off can cause distance. After arguments, sincere reconciliation will strengthen the bond.
en.money: For finances, consider partnerships or leveraging networks, but choose partners wisely and avoid losing trust through self-interest. Transparent financial arrangements bring luck, while secrecy or selfishness invites disputes.
en.meta: Fellowship: open cooperation and sincerity lead to success.

zh.summary: 大有卦是《周易》第十四卦，上离下乾，火在天上，象征盛大丰有。卦辞“元亨”意为至为亨通，但大有并非坐享其成，而是强调在拥有之后如何正确对待。爻辞从初爻到上爻，层层递进，指出拥有财富、地位或才能时，应避免伤害他人，具备担当重任的能力，乐于奉献，不炫耀，以诚信待人，并保持谦逊敬畏，如此方能获得天助，长久亨通。整体上，这一卦鼓励积极创造和合理运用资源，同时警示骄奢淫逸，倡导中庸与谦德。
lines: 初九：不与人发生利害冲突，就不会有灾祸；即使身处艰难，也能避免过错。这爻提醒我们，在富足之初，要谨慎处世，不招惹是非。
九二：像大车承载重物一样，有能力担当大事，前往行事没有过错。这爻鼓励我们，在拥有实力后，要勇于承担责任，承担得起才能行得远。
九三：公侯将财富奉献给天子，这是合乎礼制的；但小人做不到这一点。这爻暗示，有地位的人应懂得分享与奉献，而心胸狭隘者则难以做到。
九四：虽然富有但不张扬，就不会有灾祸。这爻强调，拥有很多时更应保持低调，避免因炫耀而招致嫉妒或祸患。
六五：以诚信待人，威信自然建立，吉祥。这爻指出，处于高位者应以诚感人，恩威并施，才能获得众人的信服与支持。
上九：上天保佑，吉祥而无往不利。这爻总结，当一切行为合乎天道，自然得到天助，万事顺遂。
zh.career: 事业上，大有卦预示发展顺利，可能迎来丰硕成果。但需注意：初期要避免无谓的冲突；中期要勇于承担重任，并懂得与团队分享成果；后期要低调谦逊，以诚信领导，方能持续成功。
zh.love: 感情方面，大有卦象征关系丰盈美好。初期应避免计较得失；中期要真诚付出，承担起责任；后期要以诚信和尊重维系感情，保持低调，不炫耀，感情方能长久。
zh.money: 财运上，大有卦主财富增长，但需谨慎管理。应避免因富而骄，不可炫耀；要懂得分享，投资于有价值的事业；同时保持诚信，避免投机取巧，财富才能稳固。
zh.meta: 大有卦：盛大丰有，亨通顺利，但需谦逊诚信，方能长久。

en.summary: Great Possession (Da You) is the fourteenth hexagram, with fire above and heaven below, symbolizing abundant wealth and success. The judgment 'supreme success' indicates great prosperity, but the hexagram emphasizes how to handle abundance wisely. The lines progress from avoiding harm in the beginning, to bearing responsibility, sharing with others, staying humble, building trust, and finally receiving heavenly blessing. Overall, it encourages active creation and proper use of resources, while warning against arrogance and wastefulness, promoting moderation and humility.
lines: Avoid conflict and harm; even in difficulty, you can stay blameless. This reminds us to be cautious in early success.
Like a great cart carrying its load, you have the capacity for big tasks. Take on responsibility and move forward without blame.
A prince shares his wealth with the highest cause; the small-minded cannot do this. It's about generosity and vision.
Having much but not flaunting it: no blame. Stay low-key to avoid envy and trouble.
Sincerity meets sincerity, carried with quiet dignity: fortune. Trust and respect build authority.
Heaven itself blesses this: fortune, and nothing that does not further. When actions align with the way, all goes well.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests smooth progress and potential great achievements. Avoid unnecessary conflicts early on, take on significant responsibilities, share credit with your team, and lead with humility and integrity for lasting success.
en.love: In love, this hexagram indicates a rich and harmonious relationship. Avoid nitpicking early, be sincere and responsible, and maintain trust and respect while staying humble. This will nurture a lasting bond.
en.money: Financially, this hexagram predicts wealth growth, but manage it wisely. Avoid arrogance and flaunting; invest in worthy causes, maintain integrity, and avoid shortcuts. Your wealth will then be secure.
en.meta: Great Possession: abundant wealth and success, but require humility and sincerity for longevity.

zh.summary: 谦卦讲的是谦逊之道。卦辞说“亨，君子有终”，意思是谦逊能带来通达，但真正的君子能把谦逊坚持到底。六爻从低到高，描述了谦逊的不同层次：从初爻的“谦谦君子”到上爻的“鸣谦”，强调谦逊不仅是态度，更是行动。谦逊不是软弱，而是内在的力量，能让人涉险成功，也能在必要时果断行动。此卦提醒我们，谦逊是立身之本，但也要有原则和底线。
lines: 初六：谦而又谦的君子，即使渡过大河也吉。这是说谦逊到极致，根基扎实，能克服艰难险阻。
六二：谦逊的美名传扬出去，守正则吉。谦虚被他人认可，但需保持本心，不因赞誉而自满。
九三：有功劳却依然谦逊的君子，最终吉祥。真正的谦逊是功成不居，这样的人能善始善终。
六四：没有不利，发挥谦逊的美德。谦逊不是被动，而是主动运用，能带来顺畅的局面。
六五：不靠财富而靠谦德影响他人，必要时可以征伐，没有不利。谦逊者也有威严，该出手时能出手。
上六：谦逊之声远扬，可以出兵征讨自己的城邑。谦逊到极致，也要先整顿内部，再向外行事。
zh.extra: 此卦没有用九或用六，故无额外说明。
zh.career: 事业上，谦卦提示谦逊能带来好运，但也要有实际能力。初爻提醒打好基础，九三强调功成不居，六四则鼓励主动发挥谦德。若遇阻碍，六五和上六暗示必要时需果断行动，但先要整顿内部。
zh.love: 感情上，谦卦强调谦逊和尊重。初爻的“谦谦”提醒放下身段，六二的“鸣谦”说明真诚的谦逊能打动对方，九三的“劳谦”则说付出而不居功，关系才能长久。上六提示若感情有矛盾，先反省自身。
zh.money: 财运上，谦卦不主张炫耀财富，六五“不富以其邻”说明靠谦德而非金钱影响他人。投资或理财宜低调稳健，初爻的“涉大川”暗示敢于涉险，但需有扎实准备。上六提醒若财务有乱，先理清内务。
zh.meta: 谦卦：谦逊通达，君子有终。六爻展示谦逊的层次，从谦之又谦到以谦行事，强调谦逊是力量而非软弱。

en.summary: The Modesty hexagram is about the virtue of humility. The judgment says "Modesty succeeds. The mature carry it through to the very end." The six lines describe different levels of modesty, from the humble person who is modest even about being modest, to the one whose modesty is known and who uses it to act. Modesty is not weakness but inner strength, enabling one to cross great rivers and, when necessary, to act firmly. The hexagram reminds us that humility is the foundation of character, but it must be balanced with principle and resolve.
lines: A modest person, even modest about modesty: so grounded that even the great crossing succeeds. Humility to the utmost makes one solid and able to overcome obstacles.
Modesty that sounds of itself, unforced: steady fortune. Your humility is recognized, but stay true to yourself and don't become proud of praise.
Accomplished, and still modest: such work is carried to a fortunate end. True modesty does not dwell on achievements; this leads to a good outcome.
Nothing that does not further — modesty set into motion. Humility is not passive; actively applying it brings smooth progress.
Influence without display of wealth; if firmness is required, even the modest may strike. Nothing is lost. The modest person has dignity and can act decisively when needed.
Modesty voiced aloud: begin by setting order within your own domain. Even in extreme modesty, first put your own house in order before reaching outward.
en.extra: No extra line for this hexagram (no yong jiu or yong liu).
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests that humility brings good fortune, but you need real ability. The first line advises building a solid foundation; the third line emphasizes not resting on achievements; the fourth line encourages proactive modesty. If obstacles arise, the fifth and sixth lines suggest acting firmly when necessary, but first set your own affairs in order.
en.love: In love, this hexagram emphasizes humility and respect. The first line's 'modest even about modesty' advises letting go of pride; the second line's 'sounding modesty' shows sincerity touches the other; the third line's 'accomplished yet modest' means giving without claiming credit for lasting relationships. The top line suggests if there is conflict, reflect on yourself first.
en.money: In finances, this hexagram advises against flaunting wealth. The fifth line's 'influence without wealth' means influencing others through virtue, not money. Investments should be low-key and steady; the first line's 'great crossing' suggests daring to take risks, but only with solid preparation. The top line warns that if finances are messy, first clean up your own accounts.
en.meta: The Modesty hexagram: humility leads to success, and the mature carry it through. Six lines show levels of modesty, from humbling oneself to acting with modesty, emphasizing that humility is strength, not weakness.

zh.summary: 豫卦讲的是“顺势而动”的快乐与警惕。卦辞说“利建侯行师”，指在时机成熟、人心所向时，适合有所作为，如同建立诸侯、出兵征战。但豫卦的六个爻都在提醒：快乐和热情若失去节制，就会转为凶险。初六因自鸣得意而凶，六二能持守中正而吉，六三因犹豫不决而悔，九四成为众人依附的核心，六五在约束中得以保全，上六最终觉醒改过。整体上，豫卦鼓励把握时机、激发热情，但更强调居安思危、保持清醒。
lines: 初六：到处宣扬自己的快乐和得意，会招来凶险。因为这种张扬容易引来嫉妒，也让自己失去警惕。
六二：像石头一样坚定，但不会整天僵持，能迅速判断时机，坚守正道，所以吉祥。
六三：总是仰头看别人的脸色，等待别人带来快乐，这样会后悔；如果犹豫不决，后悔会更深。
九四：众人因为你的带动而快乐，你会大有收获。不要怀疑自己，朋友们会像头发聚拢在发簪上一样团结在你周围。
六五：像得了慢性病，虽然不舒服，但不会致命。这种约束反而能让你保持清醒，得以长久。
上六：沉溺在昏暗的享乐中，但如果能醒悟并改变，就不会有灾祸。
zh.career: 事业上，豫卦提示你当前有好的时机和团队支持，适合启动项目或带领团队。但要注意不要因初期的顺利而得意忘形，要保持谦逊，并警惕潜在的隐患。像六二那样坚定而灵活，像九四那样成为可靠的核心，能助你成功。
zh.love: 感情上，豫卦提醒你，快乐和热情是关系的润滑剂，但不要只追求表面的热闹。要像六二那样，在关系中保持独立和坚定，同时像九四那样，成为对方可以信赖的依靠。避免像初六那样炫耀感情，或像上六那样沉溺于享乐。
zh.money: 财运上，豫卦显示有获利的机会，但需谨慎行事。不要因为一时的兴奋而冲动投资，要像六二那样冷静判断，像九四那样与人合作，但也要像六五那样注意控制风险，避免过度扩张。
zh.meta: 豫卦：热情与警惕的平衡，顺势而动，但需防乐极生悲。

en.summary: The Hexagram of Enthusiasm (Yu) is about the joy of moving with the times and the need for caution. The judgment says it's favorable to raise support and set things in motion, indicating a time when people are united and ready. But the six lines warn that unchecked enthusiasm turns to misfortune. The first line shows that bragging about your excitement brings trouble; the second, being firm and alert, brings fortune; the third, hesitation leads to regret; the fourth, becoming a rallying point brings great gains; the fifth, constraint preserves; the sixth, awakening from dark pleasure clears blame. Overall, Yu encourages seizing the moment and generating enthusiasm, but emphasizes staying vigilant and humble.
lines: Proclaiming your own excitement: misfortune, as it invites envy and breeds complacency.
Firm as a rock, yet not rigid—you read the signs early and act rightly, so fortune is steady.
Gazing upward, hoping for entertainment from others: regret; hesitating only doubles it.
You are the source others rally around: great gains. Don't doubt; friends gather like hair in a clasp.
A chronic ailment that doesn't kill: constraint keeps you safe and aware.
Sunk in dark pleasure—but if you wake and change course, there is no blame.
en.career: In career, Yu suggests a favorable time for starting projects or leading teams. But avoid overconfidence from early success; stay humble and watch for hidden risks. Be like the second line: firm yet flexible. Be like the fourth: a reliable core. This will lead to success.
en.love: In love, enthusiasm and joy are good, but don't chase only surface excitement. Be independent and steady like the second line, and be a trustworthy partner like the fourth. Avoid flaunting your relationship (first line) or sinking into indulgence (sixth line).
en.money: In finance, there are opportunities, but proceed with caution. Don't invest impulsively out of excitement. Judge calmly like the second line, cooperate like the fourth, and control risks like the fifth to avoid overexpansion.
en.meta: Hexagram 16, Yu (Enthusiasm): balance passion with vigilance; act in harmony, but guard against excess.

zh.summary: 随卦讲的是跟随与顺应。卦辞说“元亨，利贞，无咎”，意思是跟随得当，大为亨通，但必须坚守正道才没有过错。它强调的不是盲目跟从，而是择善而从，灵活应变。就像雷在泽下，随时而动。人生中，我们常常需要跟随他人或环境，但关键是要保持清醒，不失去自我。随卦提醒我们，在顺应中要有原则，在变化中要有定力，这样才能真正无咎。
lines: 初九：环境或职位有了变化，要灵活适应，守正才能吉祥。走出自己的小圈子，去结交他人，会有收获。
六二：如果只依恋身边的小人物，就会失去更重要的人或机会。比喻眼光要放长远，不要因小失大。
六三：跟随重要的人物，就要舍弃次要的。追随正道，有所求就能得到，但需安居守正，不可得意忘形。
九四：跟随而来有所收获，但若只为自己，则凶险。只要心怀诚信，行事光明磊落，就不会有过错。
九五：把信任交给美好的人和事，是吉祥的。代表真诚追随贤者或理想，结果良好。
上六：被紧紧束缚，却心甘情愿地追随，就像祭祀西山那样虔诚。这是极致的忠诚与奉献。
zh.career: 事业上问随卦，提示你当前适合顺应团队或行业趋势，但并非盲从。要选择正确的方向和人，灵活调整自己的角色。若已有收获，需保持谦逊和诚信，避免因利益而偏离正道。主动走出舒适区，与人合作，能带来机会。
zh.love: 感情上问随卦，意味着关系需要相互跟随与包容。若已心有所属，应坚定选择，舍弃其他诱惑。若处于犹豫中，要看清谁更值得追随。真诚和信任是关键，避免因小失大。忠诚的付出会得到美好回报。
zh.money: 财运上问随卦，提示财运亨通但需正道求财。跟随可靠的投资对象或理财趋势，但不可贪婪。若有所得，要守正防凶，避免因私利而失德。与人合作时保持诚信，财务上会更顺利。
zh.meta: 随卦讲择善而从，顺应时势而守正，方能无咎。

en.summary: The Hexagram of Following (Sui) is about adapting and following the right path. The judgment says: sublime success if you follow what is right, then no blame. It emphasizes not blind conformity but choosing the good and staying flexible. Like thunder under the lake, move with the times. In life, we often need to follow others or circumstances, but the key is to stay aware and not lose ourselves. Following reminds us to have principles in compliance and steadfastness in change, thus truly blameless.
lines: When your position changes, adapt honestly and step outside your circle; engagement succeeds.
Clinging to a lesser attachment, you lose the greater one.
Holding to the greater, you release the lesser. What you seek is found; stay grounded while keeping it.
A following brings gains, but danger if self-serving. Stay sincere and open; where is the fault?
Trust placed in what is excellent: fortune.
Held fast, bound willingly, followed to the western mountain: devotion of the deepest kind.
en.career: For career, this hexagram suggests you should adapt to team dynamics or industry trends, but not blindly. Choose the right direction and people, and adjust your role flexibly. If you have gained, stay humble and sincere, avoid deviating from integrity due to profit. Stepping out of your comfort zone and collaborating will bring opportunities.
en.love: For love, this hexagram indicates that relationships need mutual following and tolerance. If you have a partner, be firm in your choice and let go of other temptations. If hesitant, see who is more worthy of following. Sincerity and trust are key, avoid losing the big for the small. Devotion will be rewarded.
en.money: For wealth, this hexagram suggests prosperity but through righteous means. Follow reliable investment or financial trends, but do not be greedy. If you gain, stay vigilant against danger and avoid losing integrity for personal gain. Honesty in cooperation will make finances smoother.
en.meta: The Hexagram of Following teaches choosing the good and adapting to circumstances with integrity, thus avoiding blame.

zh.summary: 蛊卦讲的是面对积弊、修复衰败。卦辞说“元亨”，但前提是“利涉大川”，要像渡大河一样有准备、有行动。“先甲三日，后甲三日”强调事前事后都要周密考虑。整体不是凶卦，而是提醒你：问题已经存在，正视它、处理它，就能转危为安；放任不管，只会越来越糟。
lines: 初六：纠正父辈留下的弊病，有能干的子孙来担当，虽有小险，最终吉利。这爻提醒你，接手烂摊子时，只要认真负责，结果不会差。
九二：纠正母辈留下的问题，不宜过于刚硬。这爻说，处理某些积弊时，方式要柔和，不能一味用强，否则适得其反。
九三：用力过猛地纠正旧弊，会有些后悔，但没有大错。这爻提醒你，改革时别太急躁，即便方式欠妥，只要方向对，问题不大。
六四：放任父辈的弊病不管，这样下去必有遗憾。这爻是警醒：拖延逃避，只会让问题更严重，最终悔之晚及。
六五：纠正父辈的弊病，做得好而获得赞誉。这爻鼓励你，勇敢担当并妥善处理，会赢得认可和好名声。
上九：不侍奉王侯，以高尚的志趣为事。这爻说，当外部环境难有作为时，退守自身、坚持原则，也是一种智慧。
zh.career: 事业上，蛊卦提示你可能面临遗留问题或团队积弊。建议你正视并着手整顿，事前充分准备，事后持续跟进。不要急于求成，方式要灵活，尤其注意处理好与前辈或旧人的关系。若能稳妥推进，事业会有转机。
zh.love: 感情上，蛊卦暗示关系里可能有旧问题或心结。需要双方坦诚面对，一起修复，而不是回避或指责。过程可能不快，但用耐心和柔和的方式处理，感情能重新稳固。若放任不管，裂痕会加深。
zh.money: 财运上，蛊卦提醒你注意财务上的旧账、坏账或不良习惯。建议先理清现状，再制定计划，像渡河一样谨慎。短期不宜冒进，但通过整顿和持续管理，财务状况能逐步好转。
zh.meta: 蛊卦讲修复积弊，警示不要放任问题，强调事前准备和事后跟进，方能转危为安。

en.summary: The Gu hexagram is about confronting decay and repairing what has been spoiled. Its judgment promises great success, but only for those who take action like crossing a great river — with preparation and follow-through. The line about 'three days before and after' stresses thorough planning. This is not a doom hexagram; it reminds you that problems exist, and facing them turns danger into fortune, while neglect makes things worse.
lines: Line 1: Repairing what the father spoiled: with a capable heir, danger turns to fortune. Taking responsibility for a mess, if done earnestly, ends well.
Line 2: Repairing what the mother spoiled: proceed gently, not by rigid rule. When fixing certain old issues, be flexible; force backfires.
Line 3: Correcting the legacy a bit too forcefully: small regrets, no great fault. Don't rush reforms; even if your approach is rough, the right direction still counts.
Line 4: Indulging the decay instead of facing it: keep going this way and regret is certain. Procrastination and avoidance only worsen the problem.
Line 5: Repairing the legacy so well it earns public praise. Boldly taking on and handling problems wins recognition and a good name.
Line 6: Serving no king, no lord — setting one's own work on higher things. When external action is futile, retreating to personal integrity is wise.
en.career: In career, Gu suggests you face inherited issues or organizational decay. Confront and fix them, with thorough preparation and follow-up. Avoid haste, stay flexible, and handle relationships with predecessors carefully. Steady progress can turn things around.
en.love: In love, Gu points to old wounds or unresolved issues. Both partners need to face and repair them honestly, not avoid or blame. Patience and gentleness can restore the bond, but neglect will deepen the cracks.
en.money: For finances, Gu warns about old debts, bad habits, or neglected accounts. First clarify your situation, then plan carefully like crossing a river. Avoid short-term risks, but through cleanup and consistent management, your finances can improve.
en.meta: Gu is about repairing decay, warning against neglect, and emphasizing preparation and follow-through to turn crisis into fortune.

zh.summary: 临卦讲的是上位者或主动方如何接近、领导、影响他人。卦辞说，这种接近一开始非常亨通顺利，但要注意时机，到了八月（象征盛极转衰的节点）就可能出现凶险，提醒人们把握当下有利的窗口期，同时保持警惕，不要得意忘形。六爻展示了不同层次的“临”：从初九的真诚感召，到九二的同心协力，再到六三的甜言蜜语（不可取），六四的完全投入，六五的明智领导，最后上六的敦厚从容。整体强调真诚、智慧、及时反省，才能趋吉避凶。
lines: 初九：用真诚去接近和感召他人，相互感应，守持正道就吉祥。
九二：以真诚之心与人合作共进，吉祥，没有什么不利的。
六三：用甜言蜜语去笼络人，不会有什么好处。如果能及时醒悟并改正，就不会有灾祸。
六四：完全投入、亲身到位地去接近和治理，没有过错。
六五：用智慧来领导，懂得知人善任，这是伟大君主的风范，吉祥。
上六：以敦厚诚恳的态度接近他人，即使身处高位也不居高临下，吉祥而无灾祸。
zh.career: 事业上，临卦提示你正处于上升期，适合主动推进项目、拓展人脉。但要注意方式：真诚合作比花言巧语更能赢得信任。同时要把握时机，趁势头好的时候行动，但也要为可能的转折做准备，避免过度乐观。
zh.love: 感情上，临卦鼓励你主动接近对方，但要用真心而非套路。如果是恋爱中，要全身心投入，坦诚相待。若已有伴侣，则要像六五那样智慧地经营关系，懂得包容与引导。真诚和敦厚是长久之道。
zh.money: 财运上，临卦显示有好的机会，但需谨慎。适合与人合作投资，但不要轻信甜言蜜语的推销。要把握当前有利时机，但也要注意八月之凶的警示，即市场可能转弱，应适时收手，避免贪婪。
zh.meta: 临卦：把握当下，真诚领导，警惕盛极而衰。

en.summary: The Approach hexagram is about how those in authority or taking initiative approach, lead, and influence others. The judgment says this approach starts off very smoothly and advantageously, but warns that by the eighth month (symbolizing the peak before decline) danger may arise. It reminds us to seize the current favorable window while staying alert and humble. The six lines illustrate different levels of approach: from genuine resonance (line 1), joint effort (line 2), to honeyed words that gain nothing (line 3), full presence (line 4), wise leadership (line 5), and finally a generous, whole-hearted approach (line 6). The overall message is that sincerity, wisdom, and timely self-reflection lead to good fortune.
lines: Approaching others with genuine sincerity and mutual response: steady fortune if you stay on the right path.
A joint approach with sincerity: fortune, nothing that does not further your goals.
A honeyed, easy manner wins nothing. If you recognize this in yourself in time, you can avoid blame.
Arriving fully, being completely present in your approach: no blame.
Leading by wisdom—knowing what to delegate and when to act: the way of a great ruler. Fortune.
A generous, whole-hearted approach from someone already beyond the fray: fortune without fault.
en.career: Career: The Approach hexagram suggests you are in a growth phase, ideal for proactive initiatives and networking. But remember: sincerity and cooperation beat smooth talk. Seize the momentum now, but prepare for possible shifts, avoiding overconfidence.
en.love: Love: Approach encourages you to take the initiative, but with genuine feelings, not tricks. In a relationship, be fully present and honest. If you're together, manage it wisely like line 5—knowing how to guide and compromise. Sincerity and generosity are the keys to lasting love.
en.money: Money: This hexagram shows good opportunities, but caution is needed. Cooperating with others may be beneficial, but don't trust sweet promises. Capitalize on the current favorable time, but heed the 'eighth month' warning: markets can turn, so know when to stop and avoid greed.
en.meta: Approach: seize the favorable moment, lead with sincerity, and watch for the turning point.

zh.summary: 这一卦讲的是观察与被观察。卦辞用祭祀作比：洗净双手，还没献上祭品的那一刻，心是虔诚的，整个人被众人仰望。观卦的核心不是看热闹，而是带着敬意去理解全局，同时也意识到自己正被周遭审视。六爻从孩童般浅显的看，到透过门缝偷看，再到审视自身、考察国情，最后成为他人眼中的典范。它提醒我们：观察的层次决定认知的深度，而真正的成熟，是既能看清世界，也能坦然面对被人打量。
lines: 像小孩那样看问题，只看表面。对普通人来说无伤大雅，但如果你有责任、有见识，还这么浅薄，就尴尬了。
从门缝里偷看，视野狭窄。这种看法只适合做点小决定，对大局无益，尤其对安分守己的人还算合适。
回过头来审视自己的所作所为，然后决定是进还是退。这是自我反思的时刻，别急着行动。
观察整个国家或组织的真实状况，明白它的气象。这样的人适合做君王的宾客，参与大事。
作为领导者，要审视自己的言行是否经得起检验。如果问心无愧，就没有过错。
最后，你的人生也会被人观察。活得坦荡，让别人挑不出毛病，就没什么可懊悔的。
zh.career: 事业上，此卦提醒你先观察再行动。别急着表现，先看清团队和行业的风向。如果你是管理者，要反思自己是否以身作则。适合通过考察、调研来定策略，不宜贸然冲锋。
zh.love: 感情上，观卦提示你要多观察对方的真实为人，而不是凭第一印象。同时也要反省自己是否真诚。若关系已深，就要经得起对方和亲友的审视。
zh.money: 财运上，观卦建议谨慎观望，不要跟风投资。先研究市场、了解趋势，再出手。财运偏向于稳健，适合做长期观察后的决定，而非短线投机。
zh.meta: 观卦：观察与被观察，在审视中成长，在坦荡中立足。

en.summary: This hexagram is about observing and being observed. The judgment uses a ritual image: after washing your hands, before making the offering—that moment of collected sincerity, when all eyes are on you. Guān is not about idle curiosity; it's about understanding the whole with respect, while knowing you are also under scrutiny. The six lines move from a child's superficial view, to peeking through a crack, to examining yourself, to assessing the state, and finally to becoming a model for others. The message: the depth of your observation shapes your understanding, and true maturity is seeing clearly while facing others' gaze with honesty.
lines: Seeing things like a child, only the surface. Harmless for the untrained, but embarrassing if you're supposed to know better.
Peeking through a crack: a narrow view, fine for small matters, but not enough for big decisions.
Review your own actions, then decide whether to advance or retreat. This is a time for self-reflection, not rush.
Assess the true state of your country or organization. One who sees this clearly is fit to serve at court.
As a leader, check whether your life bears scrutiny. If you're blameless, no fault.
In the end, others will observe your life. Live so that their examination finds nothing wrong.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises observing before acting. Don't rush to show off; first understand your team and industry trends. If you manage others, reflect on setting a good example. Research and investigation are favored over bold moves.
en.love: In love, Guān suggests observing your partner's true character, not just first impressions. Also reflect on your own sincerity. If the relationship is deep, it must withstand the scrutiny of friends and family.
en.money: In finance, Guān advises caution and waiting. Don't follow trends blindly. Study the market and understand trends before investing. Favor steady, long-term decisions over short-term speculation.
en.meta: Hexagram 20, Contemplation: observe and be observed, grow through reflection, stand firm in transparency.

zh.summary: 噬嗑卦讲的是清除障碍、明断是非。卦辞说“亨，利用狱”，意思是事情能通，但需要用上刑罚或强硬的裁决来啃掉硬骨头。它提醒我们，遇到顽固的阻碍时，不能回避，而要像咬碎硬物一样果断处理。但过程中要把握好分寸：小惩可以防止大祸，用力过猛或心存偏私则可能招来反噬。这一卦强调刚正不阿、不畏艰难，同时也警示听不进劝告、一意孤行的危险。整体上，它鼓励我们在面对冲突和问题时，敢于决断，但也要讲求方法。
lines: 初九：脚上戴了刑具，伤了脚趾。这是说小惩罚能阻止大过失，提醒我们及时改正小错，避免酿成大祸，所以没有灾祸。
六二：咬嫩肉，连鼻子都咬掉了。比喻惩罚明确的小过错，虽然下手重些，但针对的是明显的问题，所以没有错。
六三：咬腊肉，遇到毒物。象征处理棘手事情时遇到不愉快的意外，虽然让人难受、有点小麻烦，但最终不会有大问题。
九四：咬带骨的干肉，得到金属箭。这是说在艰难的案件或难题中坚持到底，会有所收获，但需要保持警惕和毅力，结果吉利。
六五：咬干肉，得到黄金。说明凭借权力处理难题，虽然能成功，但带有危险，必须保持公正，才能避免过错。
上九：颈上戴着重枷，遮住了耳朵。这是警告那些不听劝告、一意孤行的人，最终会招致灾祸，凶险。
zh.career: 事业上，噬嗑卦提示你当前可能遇到顽固的阻碍，需要果断处理。但要注意方式，既要坚决又要公正，避免过度强硬。小问题及时解决，大问题坚持到底，会有收获。同时，保持警惕，不要因为权力或地位而偏私。
zh.love: 感情上，噬嗑卦意味着关系中可能存在需要解决的矛盾或隔阂。要像啃硬骨头一样，耐心但坚决地沟通，剔除障碍。但注意别用蛮力，避免伤害对方。公正对待彼此，小摩擦及时化解，感情才能更稳固。
zh.money: 财运上，噬嗑卦显示可能遇到财务上的难题或纠纷，需要果断处理。投资决策要谨慎，像咬硬物一样，仔细分析再行动。可能会有意外收获，但也要防范风险。坚持原则，公正理财，避免因贪心而陷入困境。
zh.meta: 噬嗑卦：果断清除障碍，明断是非，但需谨慎公正，防止反噬。

en.summary: Biting Through is about removing obstacles decisively and exercising judgment. The hexagram's name, Shì Kè, literally means 'biting through,' and its judgment says 'success; it is favorable to use legal proceedings.' This suggests that when you encounter a tough obstruction, you must bite through it rather than avoid it. However, the process requires balance: small corrections prevent big disasters, but excessive force or bias can backfire. The hexagram emphasizes integrity and perseverance in difficult cases, while warning against stubbornness and refusing to listen. Overall, it encourages decisive action in the face of conflict, but with fairness and method.
lines: Feet locked in the stocks at the first offense: the small correction that prevents the great one. No blame.
Biting through soft flesh, deep enough to sting: firm punishment of a clear wrong. No blame.
Biting old dried meat and striking something bitter: a resented, ugly case — unpleasant, not wrong.
Biting through dried meat on the bone and finding the metal arrow: a hard case pursued with rigor pays. Auspicious.
A tough case decided from a position of power: golden — and dangerous. Impartial, it stays blameless.
The cangue grown heavy enough to cover the ears: the one who would not hear meets disaster.
en.career: In career, this hexagram suggests you may face a stubborn obstacle that needs decisive action. But be careful to act fairly and not overly harsh. Address small issues promptly, persist through difficult ones, and you'll see rewards. Stay vigilant against bias from authority or power.
en.love: In love, Biting Through indicates there may be conflicts or barriers in the relationship that need resolution. Communicate patiently but firmly, like biting through a hard bone, to remove obstacles. Avoid using force or hurting your partner. Treat each other fairly, and resolve small frictions timely to strengthen the bond.
en.money: In finances, this hexagram warns of possible financial difficulties or disputes that need decisive handling. Be cautious in investments, analyze thoroughly before acting. There may be unexpected gains, but also risks. Stick to principles, handle money fairly, and avoid greed to prevent trouble.
en.meta: Biting Through: remove obstacles decisively, but with fairness and caution to avoid backlash.

zh.summary: 贲卦讲的是文饰与本质的关系。卦辞说“亨，小利有攸往”，意思是修饰得当可以亨通，但只利于小事，不宜大动。贲卦提醒我们，外在的装饰、礼节、形式固然重要，但终究是服务于内在实质的。就像化妆能提升气色，却不能改变骨相。六爻展示了从刻意修饰到返璞归真的过程：起初注重细节，后来明白真正的美在于自然与真实。最终“白贲”，无饰之饰，才是最高境界。这一卦鼓励我们注重修养和形象，但切勿本末倒置。
lines: 初九：修饰脚趾，舍弃车子而徒步。这表示你愿意从最基础的小事做起，不依赖外在条件，选择朴素的行动。在事业或生活初期，踏实比排场更重要。
六二：修饰胡须。胡须依附于下巴而存在，说明装饰是依附于本质的。提醒你，与其费心打扮门面，不如先巩固内在实力，否则修饰无所依附。
九三：修饰得光泽柔润，但要长久坚守正道才吉利。美丽和成功需要持续的努力和正确的原则来维持，否则只是昙花一现。
六四：修饰得素白，白马飞奔而来，不是强盗，而是求婚者。这表示简单真诚的交往反而能建立深厚关系。在合作或感情中，朴素和坦率胜于浮华。
六五：在丘园中修饰，只用一束薄礼，虽显寒酸，但终吉。说明身处高位或重要场合，不必铺张，真诚和谦逊的表示反而赢得尊重，最终结果良好。
上九：用白色来修饰，没有过错。这是文饰的最高境界——返璞归真，不刻意装饰，以本色示人。此时无需多余的外在，简单即是美。
zh.career: 事业上，贲卦提示你注重专业形象和沟通技巧，但核心是提升能力。小有进展可期，不宜冒进扩张。在团队中，真诚合作比表面功夫更能赢得信任。
zh.love: 感情上，贲卦建议你少一些套路，多一些真心。外在的约会安排或礼物是点缀，真正维系关系的是相互理解和坦诚。简单朴素的相处，反而让感情更稳固。
zh.money: 财运上，贲卦表示小有收益，适合做外观或形象上的小投资，如更新简历、改善店面，但不宜大额投机。节俭和实用主义能带来长远的好处。
zh.meta: 贲卦：文饰与本质的平衡，返璞归真才是大美。

en.summary: The Grace hexagram (Bì) explores the relationship between outer adornment and inner substance. Its judgment, 'Success in small matters,' suggests that while refinement and courtesy can smooth the way, they are only effective for modest goals. The six lines trace a journey from deliberate ornamentation to the ultimate simplicity of 'white grace,' showing that true elegance arises from authenticity, not display. This hexagram encourages us to polish our presentation and cultivate good manners, but never to mistake the surface for the core. In career, love, and finances, a touch of grace helps, but substance seals the deal.
lines: Gracing your own feet: leaving the carriage to walk. Integrity over display. Start with humble, solid steps rather than relying on showy means.
Gracing the beard: ornament follows the chin it grows from. Attend first to substance. Decoration only works when it has a solid foundation to adhere to.
Graced and glistening: keep it constant and true, and the fortune lasts. External polish needs inner steadfastness to endure.
Adorned, yet plain; a white horse arriving in haste — not a raider but a suitor. Simplicity is the truer bond. Genuine, unpretentious approaches build stronger connections.
Grace in the hill garden, with only a small roll of silk to offer: awkwardly humble, ultimately fortunate. Humble sincerity, even if modest, wins respect and leads to good outcomes.
White, unadorned grace — the highest ornament of all: no blame. The peak of refinement is simplicity, authenticity without artificial decoration.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises polishing your image and communication, but the real focus should be on competence. Expect modest progress; avoid overexpansion. Sincere teamwork outweighs superficial gestures.
en.love: In love, less artifice, more authenticity. Outward gestures are secondary; mutual understanding and honesty are what sustain a relationship. Simplicity strengthens the bond.
en.money: Financially, small gains are likely. Suitable for minor investments in appearance or branding, but avoid large speculations. Frugality and practicality pay off in the long run.
en.meta: Hexagram 22 (Grace): Balancing adornment and essence — true beauty lies in returning to simplicity.

zh.summary: 剥卦讲的是事物在衰败、剥落过程中的状态。卦辞说“不利有攸往”，意思是这时不宜有所行动，应当静守待变。全卦以床的剥落为喻，从床脚、床框、床肤，一步步深入，象征衰败从根基开始，逐渐侵蚀到核心。但剥极必复，上九“硕果不食”暗示仍有转机。这一卦提醒我们，在衰退期要认清形势，保存实力，等待时机，不要盲目妄动。
lines: 床脚被剥蚀，根基先坏。此时若忽视衰败的征兆，执意前行，必有凶险。
剥蚀蔓延到床框，灾祸在升级。如果继续否认现实，只会让危险加深。
在崩塌之中，有人能脱离破坏者，不与同流合污，这样就没有过错。
剥蚀已及肌肤，伤害直接而明显，此时凶险已至，难以回避。
像串鱼一样把宫人依次排列，秩序井然，以柔顺的方式管理衰退，反而无往不利。
硕大的果实未被摘食，君子赖以得到车乘，而小人却因此毁掉了自己的居所。
zh.career: 事业上处于下行或调整期，不宜冒进扩张，应保守观望，巩固现有基础。留意根基问题，及时修复隐患。可借机整顿内部秩序，等待行业回暖。
zh.love: 感情可能面临疏离或危机，双方关系有被侵蚀的迹象。不宜强行推进，给彼此空间，坦诚沟通，以柔克刚，或可挽回。
zh.money: 财运低迷，投资宜谨慎，避免高风险操作。注意保护现有资产，防止被侵蚀。可采取保守策略，静待时机，不急于求成。
zh.meta: 剥卦：衰败之象，不宜行动，静守待变，剥极必复。

en.summary: The Splitting Apart hexagram describes a period of decay and erosion. The judgment warns against action: "Do not go anywhere." The image of a bed being eaten away from legs to frame to skin illustrates how decline starts at the foundation and progresses inward. Yet the top line shows a great fruit left uneaten, hinting at recovery after the worst. This hexagram advises recognizing the signs of decline, conserving strength, and waiting for the turning point rather than forcing progress.
lines: The bed is eaten at its legs — the base goes first. Dismissing the signs invites ruin.
The erosion reaches the frame. It climbs; denial deepens the danger.
In the midst of the collapse, one breaks with the destroyers: no blame.
The splitting reaches the skin: harm is now direct. Misfortune.
Order the decline like a string of fish, each in place: managed loss turns to advantage.
One great fruit stays uneaten. The worthy inherit a carriage by it; the destroyer unroofs his own house.
en.career: In career, you may be facing a downturn or restructuring. Avoid aggressive moves; consolidate your position and address hidden issues. Use this time to organize and prepare for better days.
en.love: A relationship may be eroding. Avoid forcing issues; give space and communicate gently. Managing the decline with care can prevent total breakdown.
en.money: Finances are shaky; avoid high-risk investments. Protect existing assets and adopt a conservative approach. Wait for a clearer signal before acting.
en.meta: Splitting Apart: a time of decay and erosion, advises conservation, not action, with hope of renewal.

zh.summary: 复卦讲的是回归与转机。在经历剥落之后，事物开始复苏，如同冬去春来。卦辞说亨通，出入无碍，朋友来助，道路循环往复，七日一复，利于前往。这提醒我们，人生有周期，低谷后必有回升，关键是把握回归的时机。复卦强调知错能改，回归正道，无论是个人修养还是事业发展，都宜顺势而为，积极行动。整体倾向是积极向上的，但也要警惕迷失方向，一错再错。
lines: 刚起步就回头，没走远，所以不会后悔，大吉。这是说犯错要趁早改，及时止损。
欣然回归，与志同道合者同行，吉祥。表示回归正道时有人支持，环境有利。
反复犯错又反复回头，虽然危险，但能知错就改，终究无咎。说明改过不彻底，但有心向善。
在众人中独自行走，独自回归。这表示在混乱中能保持清醒，独自选择正道。
诚恳地回归，经过深思熟虑，没有后悔。这是成熟稳重的回归，值得肯定。
迷失了回家的路，凶险，有灾祸。若用于打仗，会大败，连累国君，十年都难复兴。这是警告执迷不悟的后果。
zh.career: 事业上，复卦提示你可能正处于转折点，之前的困境将逐渐好转。建议把握时机，修正过去的错误，回归正轨。初九爻强调及早回头，若已偏离方向，尽快调整。六二爻则利与人合作，共同推进。但上六爻警告勿执迷不悟，否则十年难复。整体宜积极行动，但需谨慎决策。
zh.love: 感情上，复卦表示关系有回暖的可能，或是你内心渴望回到过去的美好。若曾有过矛盾，现在适合主动修复，回归初心。六二爻提示与伴侣坦诚沟通，获得理解。但也要注意，若对方或自己反复犯同样的错（六三），需正视问题。上六爻则提醒不要迷失在旧情中，若关系已不可挽回，执念只会带来伤害。
zh.money: 财运上，复卦预示财务低谷将过，有回升迹象。宜总结过往投资教训，回归稳健策略。初九爻提醒及时止损，避免更大损失。六五爻则鼓励以诚实的财务规划，无怨无悔。但上六爻警告勿在错误方向上追加投资，否则可能大败，长期难以恢复。整体宜保守，等待时机。
zh.meta: 复卦：一元复始，万象更新。知错能改，善莫大焉；把握转机，顺势而为。

en.summary: The Return hexagram speaks of turning points and renewal. After a period of decline, things begin to recover, like winter giving way to spring. The judgment says all goes smoothly: coming and going without harm, friends arriving without blame, and the way renewing itself in seven days. It reminds us that life moves in cycles, and after a low point, recovery is possible. The key is to seize the moment of return. This hexagram emphasizes correcting mistakes, returning to the right path, and moving forward with confidence. The overall tone is positive, but there is a warning against missing the turn and persisting in error.
lines: Turning back before going far: nothing to truly regret, supreme fortune. Correct mistakes early, before they become entrenched.
A calm and willing return, in good company: fortune. You have support as you realign with your values.
Straying and returning repeatedly: precarious, yet each return leaves you blameless. You keep trying, and that counts.
Walking with the crowd, but turning back alone. Staying true to your own path amidst pressure.
A wholehearted return, examined and owned: no regrets. A mature, deliberate choice to change course.
Missing the turn entirely: disaster from within and without, defeat that takes ten years to mend. Do not double down on a wrong path.
en.career: In career, Return suggests you are at a turning point; past difficulties will ease. Seize the chance to correct course and get back on track. The first line advises early correction; the second favors collaboration. But the top line warns against stubbornly persisting in a wrong direction, which could set you back for years. Act positively, but with prudence.
en.love: In love, Return indicates a possible thaw in the relationship, or a desire to rekindle past harmony. If there have been conflicts, now is the time to repair and return to the original bond. The second line encourages open communication. But beware of repeating the same mistakes (line 3), and the top line cautions against clinging to a lost cause—obsession only brings harm.
en.money: In finances, Return signals that a financial low point is passing, with signs of recovery. Review past investment lessons and return to a prudent strategy. The first line urges timely loss-cutting; the fifth encourages honest financial planning without regrets. The top line warns against doubling down on a failing investment, which could lead to long-term ruin. Be conservative and wait for the right moment.
en.meta: The Return Hexagram: a fresh start after a downturn. Correct mistakes, seize the turning point, and move forward wisely.

zh.summary: 无妄卦强调真诚无妄、顺应自然。卦辞说“元亨，利贞”，即大通顺，利于守正。若心怀不正，必有灾祸，不宜妄动。此卦提醒我们，在顺境中保持纯真，不投机取巧，遵循正道，才能长久亨通。妄念妄动会带来不测之灾，因此要安守本分，不贪求非分之物，不行非分之事。
lines: 初九：心怀无妄，前往吉祥。此时行动，因真诚而得助。
六二：不图收获而耕耘，不望熟田而开荒，如此则利于前往。意指不求回报，但行好事。
六三：无妄之灾，如系牛被行人牵走，邑人遭疑。意指无缘无故的灾祸，非己之过，却受牵连。
九四：可守正道，没有灾祸。此时宜固守本分，不妄动。
九五：无妄之疾，不用药而自愈。意指非由己招的疾病或问题，顺其自然便会好转。
上九：无妄而妄行，有灾祸，无利可图。即使动机纯正，时机不对，行动也会有害。
zh.career: 事业上，此卦提示宜守正务实，不可投机取巧。真诚努力会带来顺利发展，但若心存侥幸，妄图非分之得，必有损失。按部就班，踏实做事，方能长久。
zh.love: 感情上，真诚相待是根本。不要玩弄心机，顺其自然发展。若遇误会或波折，非己之过，不必强求，时间会澄清一切。
zh.money: 财运上，忌贪求不义之财，宜本分理财。意外之财可能带来灾祸。稳健投资，长远规划，财运自会亨通。
zh.meta: 无妄卦：真诚无妄，守正而行；妄动招灾，顺其自然。

en.summary: The Hexagram Innocence emphasizes sincerity and alignment with the natural order. Its judgment speaks of sublime success through unspoiled sincerity, but warns that any crooked motive brings harm, and one should only go where it is right to go. This hexagram advises maintaining purity of heart, avoiding scheming, and staying on the righteous path. It cautions against reckless actions driven by selfish desires, which can lead to unexpected misfortunes. The overall message is to act with integrity and trust that things will unfold as they should.
lines: Moving from unspoiled intention brings fortune.
Reap without scheming for the harvest, clear without eyeing the third year's field — then movement furthers.
Undeserved misfortune: the tethered ox taken by a passerby, the neighbor blamed. Such things happen.
Hold to what is truly yours: no blame.
An illness not of your making: use no medicine. It passes of itself.
Even innocence must not act at the wrong hour: moving now brings harm, and nothing furthers.
en.career: In career, this hexagram advises staying true and pragmatic. Sincere effort leads to smooth progress, but opportunistic moves will backfire. Follow the established path and avoid shortcuts for lasting success.
en.love: In love, sincerity is key. Avoid mind games and let things develop naturally. If misunderstandings arise not from your fault, don't force resolution; time will clarify.
en.money: In finances, avoid ill-gotten gains and manage money honestly. Unexpected windfalls may bring trouble. Invest cautiously and plan long-term for prosperity.
en.meta: Hexagram 25 Innocence: Sincerity brings success; crooked motives bring harm. Act righteously.

zh.summary: 大畜卦讲的是积蓄力量、培养能力的阶段，强调在积累中要守正，并鼓励将所学用于社会（不家食），同时具备涉险前行的勇气。卦象上山下天，天在山中，象征巨大的蓄藏。整体上，这一卦提示我们：积累不是目的，而是为了更好的出发；通过自律和提前防范，能让积累转化为实际成果。它不是静止的积蓄，而是动态的蓄势待发，鼓励在准备好后勇敢行动。
lines: 初九：前方有危险，此时停下来反而是有利的。提醒你在起步阶段，遇到警示要懂得止步，不要硬闯。
九二：车轮的轴栓脱落了，车子暂时动不了。这可能是外部原因，也可能是自己选择暂停。重要的是不焦虑，等待时机。
九三：良马在追逐，利于在艰难中守正。要不断练习车马防卫的本领，有准备地前进，才能走得远。
六四：给小牛的角装上护木，防止它伤人。在问题刚露头时就加以约束，会带来大吉。
六五：阉割公猪，去掉它的尖牙，从根本上消除隐患。吉，因为找到了问题的根源并处理掉。
上九：天的大路畅通无阻，积蓄终于得到释放，亨通。这是积累后的通达，一切水到渠成。
zh.career: 事业上，大畜卦提示你正处于积累期，可能进展缓慢，但这正是必要的过程。建议专注提升能力，不要急于求成。同时要有全局观，提前为可能的风险做准备。当积累足够时，大胆投入更大的项目或承担更多责任，会得到好结果。
zh.love: 感情上，这一卦强调稳定和积累。单身者可能需要先提升自我，而不是急于寻找；有伴侣者则要注重日常的维护和深层信任的建立。遇到矛盾时，从根源解决，而不是表面应付。耐心的经营会让关系更牢固。
zh.money: 财运上，大畜卦是积蓄的象征，适合储蓄、投资于长期项目或自我提升。但要注意风险控制，不要因贪快而冒进。提前规划，防患于未然，财富会稳步增长。也可能有外出求财的机会，但需谨慎评估。
zh.meta: 大畜卦：蓄力待发，守正前行，利涉大川。

en.summary: Great Taming is about building capacity through discipline and preparation. It suggests that accumulation is not an end in itself but a means to serve beyond one's own circle and to undertake significant crossings. The hexagram depicts a mountain over heaven, symbolizing vast inner storage. The key message is to stay grounded, cultivate skills, and address problems early. When the time is ripe, release your potential confidently. It's a dynamic process of charging up for a meaningful launch, not passive hoarding.
lines: Danger lies ahead: the wise move is to stop now.
The axle straps are off the cart: halted by choice, waiting without strain.
Fine horses in pursuit: advance, but keep drilling the guard. Preparedness makes progress safe.
The headboard on the young ox, before horns harden: great fortune through early restraint.
The boar's tusk rendered harmless at the source: fortune by removing the root of danger.
The open highway of heaven: everything accumulated finally released — success.
en.career: In career, this hexagram points to a period of building expertise and capacity. Progress may seem slow, but it's essential groundwork. Focus on skill development and risk management. When ready, take on bigger roles or projects; your preparation will pay off.
en.love: In love, this hexagram emphasizes steady growth. If single, invest in self-improvement rather than rushing. For couples, nurture trust and address issues at their core. Patient effort strengthens the bond.
en.money: Financially, this is a saving and investing phase. Favor long-term plans and education. Avoid impulsive risks; instead, plan ahead and guard against pitfalls. Wealth will grow steadily, possibly through opportunities requiring travel.
en.meta: Great Taming: build capacity with discipline, then advance boldly.

zh.summary: 颐卦讲的是养生的智慧——不仅是吃食，更是言语、思想和人际的滋养。卦辞说‘观颐，自求口实’，意思是观察别人如何自养，也反省自己靠什么生活。关键在于‘自求’，靠自己正当努力，而不是觊觎他人。卦中初九舍弃自身灵龟去羡慕别人，凶；而六四虽依赖上位，却目标正当，无咎。整体提醒：滋养要合乎正道，依赖要认清对象，时刻保持警觉与节制。
lines: 放下你自己的灵龟（天赋和本分），却眼馋地看着别人吃东西，这很凶险。意思是丢掉自己的优势，去羡慕别人，只会失去自我。
颠倒着求养，又违背常理，还往高处攀附，这样前进会招来凶险。根基不正，再努力也白搭。
违背养生的正道，固执己见，凶险。十年都用不上，没什么好处。提醒你：方向错了，再耗十年也没用。
虽然求养的方式有点颠倒，但结果好，就像老虎盯着猎物，专心追求，反而没有过错。关键是目标正当。
偏离常规，但只要安守本分，坚守正道就吉。不适合渡大河，也就是别冒险做大事，先稳住。
成为众人依赖的养源，责任重大，虽然有惊险但最终吉利，适合渡大河。你成了关键人物，担子重但能成大事。
zh.career: 事业上，颐卦提醒你审视自己的‘饭碗’是否正。不要羡慕别人的捷径，要凭本事吃饭。若处于领导位，要像上九那样担起责任，虽辛苦但能成事。若时机未稳，像六五一样先守好本分，别急着扩张。
zh.love: 感情上，颐卦讲求互相滋养。别只盯着对方付出，自己也要有‘自养’能力。若关系里一方总依赖另一方，就像‘颠颐’，需调整。当双方都像老虎一样专注投入，关系才健康。
zh.money: 财运上，颐卦警示别贪图不义之财，要靠自己正当劳动。投资或求财要合乎常理，别走偏门。若处于财务依赖期，先稳固基本盘，别冒险。
zh.meta: 第27卦颐：养正之道，自求口实；观人自省，慎防贪婪。

en.summary: The Hexagram of Nourishment (Yi) is about how we feed ourselves—not just food, but words, thoughts, and relationships. The judgment says: 'Watch what you feed, and what feeds you.' It emphasizes self-reliance and proper sources. The lines show that coveting others' talents brings misfortune, while depending downward for a worthy purpose can be fine. The key is to nourish yourself rightly, stay alert, and avoid greed. It's a reflection on taking responsibility for your own growth and well-being.
lines: Setting down your own magic tortoise (your innate gifts) to stare hungrily at another's plate: misfortune. You lose yourself by envying others.
Seeking nourishment upside-down, leaning where you have no claim: advancing this way fails. If your foundation is shaky, effort won't help.
Nourishment against all principle: ten years useless. Nothing furthers. If your direction is wrong, even a decade won't change that.
Depending downward for a worthy end—tiger-eyed, hungry, and right: no blame. The goal is just, so the method is excusable.
Off the standard path: stay put and steady. No great crossings now. Don't take big risks; stabilize first.
The source from which others are fed: heavy charge, great fortune—even the great crossing succeeds. You become key, burdensome but capable.
en.career: In career, this hexagram asks you to examine your 'rice bowl.' Don't envy others' shortcuts; earn by your own skill. If you lead, take responsibility like the top line—hard but fruitful. If unsettled, hold your ground like line five and avoid expansion.
en.love: In love, it's about mutual nourishment. Don't just expect your partner to give; have your own resources. If one always depends, it's 'upside-down.' When both invest with focused attention, the relationship thrives.
en.money: In finance, avoid ill-gotten gains; work honestly. Investments should follow reason, not shortcuts. If in a dependent phase, secure your basics first and avoid risk.
en.meta: Hexagram 27 Yi (Nourishment): The way of self-reliance; watch your sources and avoid greed.

zh.summary: 大过卦讲的是非常时期，事物承受着超常的重压，如同栋梁弯曲。此时不宜退缩，而应积极行动，但必须谨慎，因为风险极高。卦辞说“栋桡，利有攸往，亨”，意味着虽然压力巨大，但前往仍有亨通的可能。六爻展示了在过度状态下各种应对方式：从极端谨慎到激进复兴，再到固执招祸、纠正得吉、虚华无果，直至过涉灭顶。整体上，这卦提醒我们，在非常时刻，需量力而行，既要勇敢担当，也要避免盲目冒进。
lines: 在祭品下铺上洁白的茅草，表示极端的谨慎和恭敬。即使是最小的事，用心处理，就不会有灾祸。
枯槁的杨树发出新芽，老翁娶得少妻，看似不匹配，却能相互滋养，带来新生。没有什么不利的。
栋梁弯曲而折断，象征顽固地承担过重负荷，最终导致崩溃。这是凶险的，因为不知变通。
栋梁隆起，得以支撑，是吉利的。但如果另有图谋，就会招来遗憾。关键在于动机纯正。
枯杨开花，老妇得少夫，看似风光，却无实质结果。没有过错，也没有赞誉，因为缺乏根基。
涉水过深，淹没头顶，凶险。但如果是为了正义之事，虽败犹荣，没有过错。
zh.career: 事业上，你正面临超常的压力或变革，如同栋梁承重。建议积极行动，但必须谨慎规划，避免硬撑。若有机会调整策略，纠正方向，则能转危为安。切忌虚张声势，或冒进到无法控制的地步。
zh.love: 感情中，可能遇到看似不匹配的组合，但若真心相待，反而能焕发新生。然而，若关系建立在虚浮之上，则难以持久。当压力过大时，需坦诚沟通，避免背负过重。
zh.money: 财运上，有高风险高回报的迹象，但须极度谨慎。若投资或决策过度，可能倾覆。宜采取保守策略，注重细节，避免孤注一掷。若有纠正的机会，及时止损。
zh.meta: 大过卦：非常时期，栋梁弯曲，需谨慎行动，勇于担当，但避免冒进。

en.summary: Great Exceeding describes a time of extraordinary pressure, when the ridgepole sags under excessive weight. It is not a time to retreat but to act with caution, for risk is high. The hexagram text says, "Great excess: the ridgepole sags. It is favorable to have somewhere to go; success." The six lines illustrate various responses to this overload: from extreme care to revitalizing unions, from stubborn collapse to corrective rise, from hollow brilliance to fatal overreaching. The overall message is to measure your strength, act boldly yet prudently, and avoid reckless extremes.
lines: White rushes spread beneath the offering: extreme care in the smallest things. No blame.
The withered poplar sprouts; the old man takes a young wife: an unlikely joining that revives both.
The ridgepole buckles: stubborn overload meets collapse.
The ridgepole braced and rising: fortune — unless hidden motives creep beneath it.
The withered poplar flowers — brilliance without renewal: no blame, no praise, no future.
Wading in beyond your depth, the water closing overhead: ruin — yet no fault, if the cause deserved it.
en.career: In career, you face extraordinary pressure or change. Act, but plan carefully and avoid overloading yourself. If you can adjust course, you may turn danger into safety. Beware of empty display or pushing beyond control.
en.love: In love, you may encounter an unconventional pairing, but if sincere, it can bring renewal. However, if the bond is superficial, it won't last. Under stress, communicate honestly and don't carry too much alone.
en.money: Financially, there are signs of high risk and high reward, but extreme caution is needed. Overextending could lead to ruin. Prefer conservative strategies, pay attention to details, and avoid gambling everything. If a correction is possible, cut losses early.
en.meta: Great Exceeding: a time of extraordinary pressure; act with caution, embrace responsibility, but avoid recklessness.

zh.summary: 坎卦讲的是险境重重，如水般深不可测。卦辞说，只要内心诚信、保持通达，行动就会有收获。这不是要你硬闯，而是教你在困境中守正、渐进。六爻展示了从陷溺到脱困的过程：初爻因习惯危险而深陷，二爻求小得，三爻险中勿动，四爻以诚破局，五爻盈而求平，上爻则因执迷不悟而凶。整体倾向是：面对险难，心诚则明，行稳致远。
lines: 习惯了危险，反而容易跌入深渊，这是凶险的。提醒你警惕习以为常的险境。
身处险中，只求小的收获，别急着一次脱困，小步前进才实际。
